client.description: An 'Alpaca Race' tab in the arena window (Warrior's Sanctuary) for a race run by the staff on the track of the game's own Alpaca Downhill Race (Ursun Paw Mountains). A game master opens registration on a channel (/ar open), riders join with the Join button of the tab or /ar join; the race starts 60 seconds after the 2nd rider and the chat announces the count, the time and the channel. Every rider is brought to the start line, frozen and mounted on a racing alpaca; 3, 2, 1, GO! Ride through the checkpoints in order to the finish line, following the glowing blue portal rings placed along the walkable track (a blue banner at each checkpoint, a big gate with red banners at the finish) and a trail of glowing blue lights on the ground leading to the next ring along the walkable track (around cliffs and woods; a rider who strays off the track gets lights showing the way back to it); a gold beacon on screen points to your next checkpoint and the whole course is drawn on the minimap and on the map (M); spinach and Red Bull spots give a burst of speed (Alpaca Sprint), the arrows are mud traps (Hinderers). Items and class skills are locked by the server during the race, a teleport or a portal

/api/features/detail/alpaca_racing/clien.changelog:
# alpaca_racing — CHANGELOG

## client 0.11.2 (2026-11-15) - the course path stays visible on the minimap after any click on the radar
- Cause (proved in boss_timers 0.6.4, docs/studies/window_zorder.md): the path layer `EdenArMap` was a child of `Root/Radar`, next to `Root/Radar/BG` which holds the map image. A click on the radar (+/-, globe, map) runs `moveToFront_impl` (0xB8C030), which raises `BG` over its siblings: the map image was then drawn over the path layer `EdenArMap`.
- Fix: the path layer `EdenArMap` is a child of the native `Root/Radar/mapFrame`, `AlwaysOnTop` among its children only (`mm_layer`, entry in `always_on_top_allow.json`): always over the map image, under the radar frame and buttons. Rect `{{0,0},{0,0},{1,0},{1,0}}` of the frame, so placement maths unchanged. Test: z-order model of `moveToFront_impl` + wiring check.

## service 0.7.8 (client 0.11.1 unchanged) (2026-11-15) - race names of the new races and lineages
- `RACES` said "Zumi" for the Red Panda (3), "Ursun" for the Wolf (7) and "Human" for the Ogre / Ogress and the Monkey.
  `char_info` now reads the race xid (`gender_id & 15 | ((face >> 4) & 3) << 4`, the `eden_xid` formula of
  model_change) and names 3 Red Panda, 7 Wolf, 16 / 17 Ogre, 32 / 33 Monkey. Test `test_race_names_by_xid`.

## service 0.7.7 (client 0.11.1 unchanged) (2026-11-01) - race 5 is the Turtle
- turtle_race 0.2.0 makes race nibble 5 a race of its own (the Turtle, an Anura variant). The race names of the
  service (`RACES`, shown in the ranking and player lines) now say `Turtle` for 5 instead of `Anura`. Nothing else
  changes (the racial ranking of the game still counts the Turtle with the Anura).

## service 0.7.6 (2026-10-31) - the legend announcement once
- Admin report: the same line came once per channel ("Weekly Jackpot: draw in 1 hour..." 4 times on the DEV). The GM announce (native `announce` CGI) is shown on every channel, so it is now sent once, on the first channel that answers (the next one only when it does not answer).

## client 0.11.1 / service 0.7.5 (2026-10-29) - Aven Event tab: review of 0.11.0 / 0.7.4 (two verifiers)
- Service 0.7.5: a notify whose card is not delivered (`ph_tell` without `DONE`: ZoneServer slow or busy at world
  entry, or the player already gone) keeps the player's watch entry. In 0.7.4 the card went through `Hub.send`, which
  drops the entry on any failed send, so one CGI hiccup at login took the player off Last call for the whole session
  (0.7.3 sent nothing to a notify and never dropped him). A player really gone is still dropped by the next send that
  fails (the last call chat line), as before 0.7.4.
- Client: the stop after 2 notifies without a card is no longer final until the next world entry. The tab asks again
  once every 5 minutes while it is open: a race service restarted or redeployed while the tab is open is read again
  within 5 minutes, an old race service costs one command every 5 minutes with the tab open and none with it closed.
  Log: `monster race: no card answered to 2 notifies (race service down or before 0.7.4): ... asks again every 5 min
  while it is open`, then `monster race: the race office answers the notifies again`.
- Client: once the bets countdown is over (bets closed on the server, start in 15 s or less) the tab reports 2 (tag
  `Racing`) with "Race of HH:MM: bets closed", instead of 1 (`Bets open`) with "bets are closing" until the next card
  (2 s normally, up to about 17 s after a world entry).
- Client: the refresh decision is a pure helper (`mr_peek_step` / `mr_peek_sent`, monster_race_logic.h); `mr_peek`
  only gathers the state, calls it and sends. test_mrace runs it: unit checks (tab read 2 s ago or not, read a few ms
  ahead of the world tick or 30 days ago, window open or answer pending, 8 s answer wait, 15 s gap, misses forgotten
  on a card) and timelines against a simulated race office (300 ms round trip): tab open for 2 races = 4 notifies a
  race, 15 s apart at least, tab state at most 2.5 s behind the real phase; tab closed = none, opened again on an
  expired card = one at once; window open = none; race service down 65 s = 2 notifies, one more 5 minutes later, then
  the normal pace; old race service = one every 5 minutes with the tab open, none with it closed.
- Docs: the worst-case card line is 126 px ("Bets close in 1439:59"), not 124 (0.11.0 entry corrected).
- Tests: monster race 165 (+2), client logic 829 -> 851, refresh wiring check rewritten for the helper. The real Aven
  Event card (prop_hunt's hub harness and renderer, the status entry replaced by a stub) rendered for 9 states and
  looked at: nothing cut, tags `Bets open` / `Racing` / `Every 20 min` / `Off` as expected.

## client 0.11.0 / service 0.7.4 (2026-10-29) - Monster Race state for the Aven Event tab
- Client: new `int alpaca_racing_monster_race_status(char* line, int cap)` (alpaca_racing.h), read by the Aven Event
  tab of prop_hunt through its weak symbol: -1 off (feature or part off: "Monster Race is off: Settings > Features";
  race service without the Monster Race: "Not on this server yet"), 0 nothing on, 1 bets open, 2 race (bets closed and
  start due, or running). Lines split by the hub at the first ': ': "Race of HH:MM: bets close in m:ss" (local time and
  countdown of the window), "Race of HH:MM: starts in 0:ss", "Race of HH:MM: running now", "Race of HH:MM is over: next
  bets in m:ss", "Next race at HH:MM: bets open in m:ss", "Race office closed: back in a moment"; no card known = empty
  line (the hub keeps its fixed schedule). Every line fits 2 card lines of 148 px at F001-9, measured with the hub's
  own (widest) glyph table; worst case 126 px ("Bets close in 1439:59").
- Client: the state stays live with the window closed. The world-entry `ar mr notify` now brings the card; while the

Pick a monster: click a monster's name -> its row gets a gold frame, the name reads '> Name' in gold and the band says 'Your pick: Name (xN.N) - 10,000 gold pays ...'.
Bet amount: press - and + -> the amount moves between 1,000 and 1,000,000 and 'pays ...' follows. Outside the bet phase (race running or finished) - and + are greyed.
Confirm box, No: pick a monster, press Bet -> a Yes/No box asks 'Bet 10,000 gold on Name (xN.N)? A win pays ... gold by mail.' Press No -> nothing happens and no gold is taken.
Confirm box, Yes: press Bet, then Yes -> your gold drops by exactly the bet, a short sound plays, the chat says 'Monster Race: bet placed: ...' and your bet shows in the monster's row.
Gold left: after a bet -> the note under the band reads 'Bet placed: <amount> gold on <monster>. Gold left: <amount>.' with the gold you really have left.
Same monster twice: bet again on a monster you already bet on in this race -> refused with a red 'You already bet on ...' line, no gold taken.
Several bets: in the same race bet 10,000 on 7 different monsters -> each of the 7 rows shows 10,000 and the band reads 'Your bets: 70,000'.
Not enough gold: try to bet more gold than you carry -> the bet is refused with a message and no gold is taken.
Outside Aven: open the Monster Race window on another map -> you can watch the race, Bet is greyed and the note says bets are taken in Aven only. Back in Aven, a bet goes through.
Trade open: with a trade window open, try to bet -> refused, no gold taken.

(GM) Game master: open the Monster Race window with a game master character -> Bet is a plain dark button and the note reads 'Game masters watch the Monster Race but cannot bet.'; no confirmation box opens.
Last call on: tick Last call in the window, close it -> about one minute before a race the chat says 'Monster Race: last call! ...', even if you never opened the window since login.
Last call off: untick Last call -> no 'last call' chat line before the next races.
Bets close: keep the window open when bets close -> it shows 'bets closed', then with sound on 3 ticks at 3, 2, 1 and a start fanfare.
Race running: during the race -> every bead runs along its dirt lane with a coloured trail and the number boxes change to 1st ... 8th as the places change.
Winner: when the winner crosses the line -> its own cry plays and the window says '<Monster> wins the HH:MM race! Next bets in m:ss'.
Winning bet: bet on the winner -> win fanfare, the note says 'You won X gold (bets Y): it comes by mail.' and ONE mail 'Monster Race winnings' arrives with exactly bet x odds gold.
Claim winnings: open the 'Monster Race winnings' mail and take the gold -> your gold goes up once by that amount; the mail cannot be claimed twice.
Losing bet: bet on a monster that does not win -> the note says 'No win this time (bets Y).' and the chat says your bets are lost and gives the next race time.
Auto-open: tick Auto-open, bet, close the window -> at the race start the window opens by itself with the 8 runners and your bet in its row.
Relog before the start: bet, log out and back in before the race starts (Auto-open ticked) -> at the start the window opens by itself, with your bet in its row and the beads moving.
Channel change before the start: bet, then change channel before the race -> the window opens on the new channel at the start and the result chat line arrives there.
Check boxes kept: change Last call and Auto-open, relog -> both keep the state you chose.
Next race: keep the window open after a race -> when the next bets open it shows the new race with a countdown, never stuck on 'in 0:00'.
Sound muted: mute the game sound in the options, watch a race with a bet -> no tick, fanfare, cry or jingle plays.
Closing: Escape, the X and Close each close the window; with the '?' help open, Escape closes the help first.
Escape order: open the Loot Tracker (Alt+L), then the Monster Race window -> the first Escape closes Monster Race, the second the Loot Tracker.
Log out during a race: with the window open, go back to character select -> nothing stays on screen; a winning bet still sends its mail.
Aven Event tab, bets: arena window > Aven Event > Monster Race while bets are open -> tag 'Bets open' (green), 'Race of HH:MM' / 'Bets close in m:ss', same time and countdown as the window.
Aven Event tab, race: keep the tab open when bets close -> 'Racing' (gold) with 'Bets closed', then 'Starts in 0:13' counting down, 'Starting now', then 'Running now'.
Aven Event tab, after: when the last runner is in -> 'Every 20 min' with 'Race of HH:MM is over' / 'Next bets in m:ss', then 'Bets open' for the next race. Each tag changes within about 3 s.
Tab button: on the Alpaca Race tab, the 'Monster Race - bet gold' button sits under the event line; switch to other tabs and back -> it shows on the Alpaca Race tab only, no empty band elsewhere.
Window key: on the character selection screen press the 'Monster Race: window' key (if you bound one) -> nothing opens; in game the same key opens and closes the window.
Monster Race option: Settings > Features > untick 'Monster Race bets (Aven)' -> the window and Kimoso's button disappear at once; tick it -> the button is back at the next talk to Kimoso.
Feature off: Settings > Features > untick 'Alpaca Racing' -> no Monster Race window, icon or Kimoso button; the rest of the game is normal. Tick it again -> they come back.
(GM) Cancel a race: type /ar mr cancel <race id> on the open race -> every bet comes back by mail; another character pressing Bet then gets 'Bets for this race are closed.', no gold taken.
(GM) Audit: type /ar mr audit -> the chat says 'no anomaly' with the totals staked, paid and kept.
Result window: when the race ends -> each rider gets a result window with every place and time, a jingle plays and he is back on foot.
Other tabs: after looking at the Alpaca Race tab, open the other tabs of the arena window -> they look and work as before.
Other NPCs: talk to any other NPC of Aven -> no 'Monster Race' button in his dialog.
Tab button: on the Alpaca Race tab press 'Monster Race - bet gold' -> the 'Monster Race' window opens.
Screen sizes, clicks: at 2560x1440 open a game window over the Monster Race window -> that game window can still be clicked.
(GM) Race info: type /ar mr info -> the chat shows the current Monster Race.
Not a GM: a normal player types /ar mr audit, then /ar mr info -> nothing is shown to him.
Two riders: two players race together -> both see the same places on the live ranking during the race.
Two riders, results: at the end of a race with two players -> both get the same result window, with the same places and times.
Party: two players of the same party join the same race -> both are registered and race as two riders; they are still in the party after the race.
Death during a race: if your character dies during a race -> after reviving you are not frozen, not on a racing alpaca, and items and skills work.
Two bettors: two players bet on different monsters in the same race -> each one sees only his own bet in the rows and in 'Your bets'.
Two winners: two players both bet on the winner -> each one gets his own 'Monster Race winnings' mail with his own bet x odds.
Winnings after relog: win a bet, log out before opening the mail, log back in -> the 'Monster Race winnings' mail is there with the same gold.
Bets kept after relog: bet on 2 monsters, relog before the race -> both bets still show in their rows and 'Your bets' gives the same total.
Spam Bet: press Bet, then Yes, several times very fast on the same monster -> only one bet goes through and your gold drops only once.
Bets closed: open the window when it says 'bets closed', pick a monster -> Bet does not take any gold.
Monster Race option kept: untick 'Monster Race bets (Aven)', relog -> it is still unticked and Kimoso has no 'Monster Race' button.

checklist.item: Archive window: open Treasure Archive -> a Search box ('Name, description or #id'), a race/sex list ('Any race/sex') and a quality list ('Any quality') show above the grid.
Tick boxes stress: open Body Gear, click the game's tick boxes many times in a row, alone and together (untick both Treasure Only boxes = empty grid, Owned Treasure Only, Reverse) -> no crash.
Search with no result: in Body Gear type 'zzzz' -> grid empty and 'No item found', no crash; then tick and untick the game's tick boxes with that search on -> no crash.
No phantom filter: open the quality list, move the mouse over the rows down to Purple, click outside without choosing -> the list still shows 'Any quality' and the grid is not filtered.
Count: no search and both lists on Any -> no count shows. With a search or a filter -> '<N> found' equals the costumes in the grid; 'No item found' only when the grid is empty.
Loading speed: open Body Gear -> the grid fills in about a second the first time, then almost at once when you come back to it.
Search speed: in Body Gear type 'kitty' -> a moment after the last key the matching costumes appear all at once (not one by one) and '<N> found' shows right away.
Owned slot turns on: archive open on a category -> archive a costume from your bag -> its slot turns from grey to owned at once and Rate goes up.
Appearance tree: Appearance shows Head, Face, Special, Back Gear, Body Gear, 1H Weapon, 2H Weapon, Off-Hand, in that order; Head holds hats only, Face glasses and masks.
Rate per leaf: on every Appearance leaf 'Rate: x%' = owned / listed. Archive a face costume -> the Face rate goes up, Head does not.
Report panel: the panel at the bottom lists Head, Face, Special, Back Gear, Body Gear, 1H Weapon, 2H Weapon, Off-Hand, then the other categories, with counts matching the leaves.
Search: type 'kitty ears' in the Search box -> only matching costumes show, packed from the top-left with no holes, and '<N> found' above. Clear the text -> the full category comes back.
Search by id: Treasure Archive open -> type '#40500' in the Search box -> only the item with id 40500 shows.
Accents and case: type 'MENS', then "men's", then 'Mens' in the Search box -> all three give the same result.
Race/sex list: Male hides women-only costumes, Female hides men-only ones; Zumi, Anura, Ursun show what that race can wear; 'Wearable by me' shows what your character can wear.
Quality list: the rows are coloured like item names (Grey to Purple) -> choose Purple -> only purple-named costumes show.
Combined filters: search + race/sex + quality + Owned Treasure Only + Reverse together -> only items passing every filter show, in reverse order, and the count updates.
Filters per character: set Male and Gold on character A, log in with B -> both lists at Any; back to A -> Male and Gold again.
Enter in the Search box: type a word, press Enter -> the text stays, the box is left and no chat line opens.
Interface size: at interface size 1.0, 1.2 and 1.5 the Search box and both lists never cover the game's tick boxes, the lists open and close, the tick boxes still work.
Archive Save size: open Archive Save (the protection list) -> it has 60 slots (6 x 10).
Character creation: on the character creation screen the costume preview tabs (Head, Back, Body, Weapon) still list face, special and weapon costumes as before.
Stability: with a search and filters on, switch leaves many times, teleport with the archive open, relog, go to character select and back -> no crash, filters restored, Search box empty.
Two game windows: archive open in both with different searches and filters on two characters -> each keeps its own; Enter or Esc in one does not change the other.
Archive All asks first: click Archive All in your bag -> a Yes/No box 'Archive every item you can? This cannot be undone.' -> No (or Escape) archives nothing.
Archive All, Yes: click Archive All, then Yes -> every item that can be archived goes in; items already archived or on Archive Save stay in the bag.
Gems: in Armor > Gems archive a socket gem from your bag -> it shows as owned and Rate goes up. Right-click it -> it comes back to the bag.
Gem filters: in Armor > Gems try Owned Treasure Only, Reverse, the search ('body gem') and the level and type lists -> each works; gems without stats stay listed with Magical or Physical.
Glyphs: put a glyph in the archive slot and press Archive -> it leaves the bag and shows as owned in Special Items > Glyphs. Right-click it -> it comes back with its stats and time left.
Card leaves: Treasure Archive > Special Items lists Monster Cards, Boss Cards, NPC Cards and Place Cards between Title and Other Items, cards grey until owned.
Retrieve all: in a category where you own items click 'Retrieve all', then Yes -> the owned items shown come back to your bag one by one. Stop halts it.
Retrieve all, bag full: almost full bag -> 'Retrieve all' -> it stops with 'Treasure Archive: your bag is full.' and nothing is lost.
Right-click to Archive Save: Archive Save open, right-click an item in your bag -> it goes into the first free slot instead of being used or equipped.
Archive Save refusals: right-click an item that cannot be archived -> 'This item can't be archived, so it can't go in Archive Save.'; one already in -> 'This item is already in Archive Save.'
Level list: in a gear category choose a 'Required level' range -> only items of that level range show and the count updates.
Magical or physical list: in a gear category choose Magical, then Physical -> only items with those stats show; Any shows all again.
Help buttons: click the '?' in the title bar of Treasure Archive, then of Archive Save -> each opens a help panel that explains its window.
Archived items kept: archive a few items, relog and change channel -> they are still owned in the archive and still gone from the bag.
Confirm option off: Settings > Features, under Archive untick 'Confirm Archive all' -> Archive All archives at once, no Yes/No box. Tick it again -> the box is back.
Right-click option off: under Archive untick 'Right-click to Archive Save' -> with Archive Save open, right-clicking a bag item uses or equips it as in the normal game.
Retrieve option off: under Archive untick 'Retrieve all button' -> the 'Retrieve all' button is gone. Tick it again -> it is back, no restart.
Whole feature off: untick Archive in Settings > Features -> the Search box and the lists go away and the archive works like the normal game. Tick it again -> they come back.
Search by id, other form: type 'id:40500' in the Search box -> only the item with id 40500 shows, the same as with '#40500'.
Search by number: type '405' -> items whose id starts with 405 show, plus items with 405 in their name.
Search by description: type a word you read in an item's tooltip description -> that item shows.
Chinese search: type Chinese with the IME in the Search box -> the typing shows normally and the search finds matching items.
Clear button: type a search and set both lists -> click the x button -> the text is cleared and both lists go back to Any.
Esc in the Search box: type a word, press Esc -> the text is cleared. Press Esc again -> the box is left.
No hotkeys while typing: type letters like I, K or M in the Search box -> they go in the box and no game window opens.
Archive Save after relog: put items in Archive Save slots 31 to 60 -> relog -> they are still there, and Collect All does not take them.
Retrieved items after relog: 'Retrieve all' a few owned items, then relog -> they are in your bag and their archive slots are grey again.

/api/features/detail/archive/client?nowa.changelog:
# archive — Changelog

Version: `ARCHIVE_VERSION` in `client/code/archive.h`, logged at start-up as `[feature_version] archive = v1.11.3`.

## [1.11.7] - 2026-11-15 - Wearable by me for the Red Panda and the Wolf
- `arc_base_gender` : Red Panda (3) wears every Zumi item (bit 2), Wolf (7) every Anura item (bit 4, wolf_race item rule base 4). Before, both got `1 << nibble` only: an empty list.
- Tests: `client/tests/core/test_core.c` (Red Panda mask 0x0C, Wolf mask 0x90 = the Anura hits).

## [1.11.6] - 2026-11-05 - Wearable by me for races 10-15
- `arc_base_gender` : Golem (10) wears every Ursun item (bit 6), Bunny 12/13 the Halfkin ones (bits 8/9), Dragon 14/15 the Human ones (bits 0/1), like the Turtle with the Anura bit 4 (item race rule "own bit else the base bit").

## [1.11.5] - 2026-11-01 - Wearable by me for a Turtle
- turtle_race 0.2.0: a Turtle (race nibble 5) wears every Anura item (item race bit 4, client and server). The
  "Wearable by me" filter used `1 << nibble` only (bit 5), so it hid the 344 Anura-only items from a Turtle. For nibble 5
  it now keeps the items of bit 5 or bit 4 (`arc_filter_set`, `archive_core.h`); every other race is unchanged.
- Tests: `client/tests/core/test_core.c` (Turtle = the Anura hits, mask 0x30).

## [1.11.4] - 2026-10-28 - Archive Save at 60 slots on the RFG client 8.x
- The 60-slot protection list was armed only when `CollectionSet.layout` could be read (pkg via `eden_pkgfs_read` or
  loose file) and had `SlotIMG60` (1.11.3). The RFG client 8.x has no pkg and no loose file (data in encrypted
  `rfg\` archives), so 1.11.3 left Archive Save at 30 slots there, while the prod DLL 0.658 (1.11.2, no check) armed
  60 slots for every 8.0.0 player without any crash at the archive window (57 crash reports read, none in
  `sub_A0D590`): the RFG client ships the 60-slot layout.
- Now: no readable layout and `rfg\source
Assets_*.rfg` next to the game = armed at 60, one `[feature_init]` line
  says why. A readable 30-slot layout still keeps 30 slots, with or without `rfg\`.
- Tests: save sites, 4 new checks (RFG client armed, line written, RFG folder with a readable 30-slot layout not
  armed, folder removed = not armed).

## [1.11.3] - 2026-10-26 — client: 60-slot Archive Save only with the 60-slot CollectionSet.layout
- **Crash with a pristine or old pkg (no SlotIMG31-60 in `CollectionSet.layout`)**: the CollectionSet window build
  (`sub_A0D590`) loops over `Root/CollectionSet/Item/SlotIMG1..N` with N patched 30 -> 60 (`0xA0DE47`) and uses
  the window returned by `sub_78E0F0` with no NULL check (`*(v61 + 48)`); the game's `getWindow` (`0xBA5C10`)
  returns NULL for an absent name, so slot 31 = access violation when the window is built. The prod CDN pkg has the
  60-slot layout, a pristine pkg has 30.
- `archive_save_start` now reads the client's `UIData\layouts\CollectionSet.layout` first (pkg through
  `eden_pkgfs_read` and the loose file next to `game_.exe`): the 60-slot patch is armed only if every copy found has
  `SlotIMG60`. Otherwise nothing is patched, the protection list stays at the native 30 slots, and one
  `[feature_init] archive v1.11.3: 60-slot protection NOT armed: CollectionSet.layout of this client (pkg: ...,
  loose file: ...)` line says why. Right-click to Archive Save already uses the list's own size (30 or 60).
- Archive Save help: "It has 60 slots (6 x 10)" -> "One item per slot" (true at 30 and at 60).
- Host tests: save 52/52 (+11: 30-slot pkg layout, no layout, old 30-slot loose layout over a 60-slot pkg, loose
  only, both 60).

## [1.11.2] - 2026-10-22 — client: help "?" on the Treasure Archive and on Archive Save; Retrieve all tooltip wrapped
- **Help "?" in the title bar of the Treasure Archive (`Root/collectionWnd`) and of Archive Save (`Root/CollectionSet`)**,
  left of the X (shared `utils/helppanel`: the game's own help panel, the one of the Class Glyph "?"). The native
  "?" buttons of the archive (tree panel, Collection box) are untouched. Treasure Archive: how the search works (name,
  description, #id, all words required, case/accents/punctuation ignored, 'N found', x clears), the race/sex,
  quality, level and type filters, Retrieve all (Yes/No, stops). Archive Save: protection list, 60 slots, no
  duplicates, drag or right-click from the bag, Shift/Ctrl + right-click stays native, Save keeps the list per
  character. The archive "?" is attached once each time the search bar is built (start, Game Reset, new window) and
  removed when the feature is turned off; the Archive Save "?" once per world session from the Retrieve all tick
  (500 ms tries until the window exists, then nothing: the idle budget of 1.10.4 is kept), removed at stop. Help
  texts in `client/code/archive_help.h`.
- **Retrieve all tooltip** was 54 characters on one line (CEGUI tooltips do not wrap): now two lines of at most 52.
  The other tooltips of the archive (search box, x, the 4 filters) were already short.
- Host tests: search 248/248 (+13: "?" attached once per build, again after a Game Reset, removed and back at each
  OFF/ON round, help texts 6-25 lines without CEGUI markup, tooltips within 52 columns), take_wnd 26/26 (+6: Archive
  Save "?" at the first message, not polled while idle, back after a Game Reset, removed at stop, Retrieve all tooltip
  within 52 columns); emulation stubs updated.

## [1.11.1] - 2026-10-22 — client: Magical / Physical filter keeps Gems, Glyphs, Stones, Title and card sheets; lighter Retrieve all button check
- Preprod #35 ("Type filter doesn't work for Gems"): the Magical / Physical filter only knew items with STR, INT, WIS or
  G-Healing, so with Magical or Physical selected about 80% of the Gems sheet disappeared (477 of 598 gems have none of
  these), and Glyphs, Stones, Title, Enchantments and the card sheets lost most of their entries. A Special Items entry
  (gem, glyph, enchantment or misc item) without these stats has no Magical / Physical split and now shows with any
  type; gems with INT or STR st

checklist.item: Party side: queue for the 5v5 arena with your party -> when the match starts, every member of your party is on the same team.
Keep party: play a 5v5 match with your party -> inside the arena and back in town after the match, you are still the same party with the same leader (not a raid).
No Defectioner: leave an arena match early (or disconnect and log back in) -> no 'Defectioner' debuff, and you can queue again right away.
1v1 level: try to sign up for the 1v1 arena -> below level 80 it is refused; at level 80 it is accepted.
1v1 class change: queue for the 1v1, try to change class -> refused ('Cannot switch Class while queuing for Arena'). During a round: refused too. Before round 1 and between rounds: allowed.
1v1 ranking: open the arena ranking -> the 1v1 shows one 'All Classes' list; wins earned with 2 different classes add up on the same line.
Spectate button: Settings > Features, tick 'Arena spectator mode' under Arena -> in the Arena window a 'Spectate' button shows above Join, only on the tab of an arena that is open.

(GM) Spectate: a GM opens the 1v1 with /set_colosseum_open 1 3 2 0. Click Spectate -> Join becomes 'Leave Queue'; when two fighters start, you are sent in about 10 s later with a 'Spectating...' bar and a Leave button.
Spectating: while you watch -> the fighters cannot see or target you, you run about 3 times faster but cannot leave the arena, skills, items, chat and trade are refused, attacks never hurt you.
Spectator back: when the match ends, or when you click Leave -> you are back where you were, visible, at normal speed, and can queue again. Spectators get no reward and no ranking line.

(GM) 3v3 relog: GM opens the 3v3 for 4 (/set_colosseum_open 1 0 4 0). In a round a fighter closes the game, quillash back in fast -> he gets the arena popup and is back in the same match, same team, about 10 s later.
Relog too late: same, but log back in only after the match ended -> nothing happens, you stay in town and can queue again.
Spectator disconnect: a spectator closes the game during the match and quillash back in -> he is never sent back into the arena, he stays where he logged in.
1v1 disconnect: in a 1v1 round, one fighter closes the game -> he loses the match, even if he quillash back in quickly.
Relog message: the fighter who quillash back in during a running 3v3 -> the chat says 'Your 3 vs 3 arena match is still running...' before he is sent back.
5 per side: queue for the 5v5 with 10 or more players -> each side has at most 5 players, never 6.
Two parties: two parties of up to 5 queue for the 5v5 at the same time -> each party plays on its own side, never split between the teams.
Party commands after a match: after a 5v5 with your party -> the leader can still invite and kick, party chat works, nobody is shown as a raid member.
Keep party in the 3v3: queue for the 3v3 with your party -> during and after the match you stay the same party, not a raid.
No Defectioner after an arena: leave a 3v3 or a 1v1 early -> no 'Defectioner' debuff; you can sign up for Battle Royale or another arena at once.
1v1 any class: two level 80 characters of different classes queue for the 1v1 -> they are matched together in the same queue.
1v1 ranking off: Settings > Features > Arena, untick 'Arena 1v1 ranking' (restart if the row asks) -> the ranking shows the game's usual class lists again. Tick it back -> 'All Classes'.
Spectate off: Settings > Features, untick 'Arena spectator mode' -> the Spectate button disappears from the Arena window. Tick it again -> it comes back.
Spectate hidden on closed arenas: open the Arena window on the tab of an arena that is closed -> no Spectate button there.
Spectator help: while spectating, click the '?' of the Spectating bar -> the text says: invisible, about 3 times faster, no skills, items, trade or chat, camera zooms out further, no reward.
Spectator camera: while spectating -> you can zoom the camera out further than usual; after leaving, the zoom is back to normal.
Spectator chat: while spectating, try to talk in normal, party and whisper chat, and to send a mail -> all refused; after leaving the arena, chat works again.
Spectator party rule: a party member of one of the fighters clicks Spectate -> he is not sent to that match; he waits for the next match without his party in it.
Spectator limit: 6 players click Spectate for the same arena -> at most 5 are sent to the next match; the 6th waits for the following one.
Spectator level: a character under level 30 clicks Spectate -> refused ('Spectator mode: the server did not accept the request.'), he stays where he is.
Spectate while queued: queue to fight, then click Spectate on the same arena -> refused with 'Spectator mode: the server did not accept the request.', your fight queue is kept.
Spectator and monsters: in a monster arena, a spectator stands next to the monsters -> they never attack him.
Arena rewards: win a 3v3 or 5v5 match -> the usual rewards, honor and ranking points arrive, nothing is missing.
Relog teammate: the fighter sent back into a running 3v3 -> his teammates still see him as a teammate and can heal and buff him.
Arena off: Settings > Features, untick 'Arena' (restart if the row asks) -> no Spectate button and the 1v1 ranking shows the game's usual class lists; tick it -> both come back.
Server rule, option off: with 'Arena' unticked, leave an arena match early -> still no 'Defectioner' debuff, you can queue again at once.
Server rule, option off: with 'Arena' unticked, play a 5v5 with your party -> you are still on the same team and the same party (not a raid) after the match.
Spectate spam: click Spectate 5 times quickly -> one request only: Join reads 'Leave Queue', no repeated chat line, nothing freezes.

(1.2.0) Player lists: open the Arena window on the 3 vs 3 tab -> under the arena picture a panel 'Waiting room', 'Matches in progress' appears within a second (DEV with arena server 1.2.0). On Prop Hunt / Alpaca Race tabs it is not there.

(1.2.0, GM, 2 accounts) Waiting room: GM opens the 3v3 for 4 (/set_colosseum_open 1 0 4 0). Account A clicks Join -> on account B's Arena window (3 vs 3 tab) 'Waiting room (1)' shows A's name within 5 s; A leaves the queue -> 'Nobody is waiting.'

(1.2.0, GM, 4 accounts) Match in progress: when the 3v3 starts, every other player's 3 vs 3 tab shows 'Matches in progress (1)', 'Match 1 - started just now', the Red team and Blue team names; the 5 vs 5 tab shows 'No match in progress.'

(1.2.0) Watch: with 'Arena spectator mode' ticked in Settings > Features, a free player clicks Watch on the running match -> chat 'you will be sent to the 3 vs 3 match in progress', the arena popup, about 10 s later he is inside, invisible, with the Ghost mode bar; the panel line 'Watching (1/5): <his name>' and his button reads 'Watching'. Leave brings him back.

(1.2.0) Watch greyed: spectator part off -> Watch greyed, tooltip 'Turn on Arena spectator mode in Settings > Features'. Queued for the arena -> greyed. Settings > Features, untick 'Arena player lists' -> the panel disappears at once.

/api/features/detail/arena/client?nowait.changelog:
## [1.3.0] - 2026-11-11 — spectator no longer leaves players invisible for good (server 1.3.0: spectator part 0.5.0)
- Prod finding (read-only, 2026-11-11): the spectator arrival sets the native GM invisibility bit (CCharacter+0x3C 0x20)
  and the game saves it in player_characters.flags ("Invisible"), so a normal player who had spectated stayed
  invisible across relogs: unseen in dungeons, untargetable (IsMyEnemy false, AOE misses) and missing from his
  teammates' view in his next arena match.
- Fix (ZoneServer cave only, mempatch, no new site, same 30 ZoneServer / 15 MissionServer sites): the cave remembers
  per character id (64 slots) when it is the one that set the bit; when the spectator leaves (CharacterLeave, Z10)
  it clears only that bit. A GM who was already invisible before spectating keeps it.
- Self-repair at world entry (MigrationDone, Z13), before the native handler runs and so before the character is shown
  to others: a character that is not a spectator inside an arena and has the bit is cleared if it is a normal
  player (CCharacter+0x63C <= 0) or if the cave set it. No client broadcast is sent (the clear happens before the
  native MigrationDone presents him).
- Two new counters in the cave state (visclr, visfix). Tests: emulation cases for leave, GM kept, stuck player
  cleared, run bit kept, fighter untouched.

## [1.2.0] - 2026-10-31 — who waits, who fights, who watches, and Watch (client 1.2.0: rosters 0.1.0, spectator 0.3.0; server 1.2.0: spectator part 0.4.0, option rosters)
- Admin request: in every arena tab of the arena window (1 vs 1, 3 vs 3, Monster Battle, 5 vs 5), show who is in
  the waiting room, who fights in each running match (both teams), who is spectating, and a direct way into the
  spectator mode.
- New client part `rosters` ("Arena player lists", Settings > Features, on by default, live toggle): a panel in the
  native arena window, over the lower part of the arena picture, with the native frame and background of the rules
  box and black text like the native texts. It shows "Waiting room (N)" with the names (2 lines, "+N more"),
  "Waiting to watch (N)", "Matches in progress (M)" with < 1/M > when several, "Match i - started N min ago", the
  Red team and Blue team columns, "Watching (n/cap)", and a **Watch** button per match. The panel grows with the
  match shown and is hidden on the other tabs (Prop Hunt, Alpaca Race) and when the part is off.
- Watch sends you into that running match at once as an invisible spectator, through the spectator part (same
  request state, same teleport, same Ghost mode bar and Leave). Greyed with a tooltip when the spectator part is off
  ("Turn on Arena spectator mode in Settings > Features"), when you are queued or in an arena, or when the match
  already has the maximum number of spectators; "Watching" on the match you watch. The Spectate button next to Join
  is unchanged (it queues you for the next match).
- Traffic: one list request when the window opens on an arena tab or the tab changes (never less than 2.5 s apart),
  then one every 5 s while it stays open; nothing when the window is closed. The panel only appears once the server
  has answered: a server without the new spectator part (prod today) shows nothing, and after two unanswered requests
  the DLL stops asking until the next Game Reset.
- Server (mempatch only, no new site, same 30 ZoneServer / 15 MissionServer sites): ZoneServer `zsp_op_c` takes op
  0x5350 arg `0x30000|mode` (list, no game gate, 2 s per character on its own gate so a list never eats a click) and
  `0x40000|(csid&0xF)<<2|mode` (Watch, same gates as the spectator queue); MissionServer `msp_answer` answers a list
  with native `CNC_ZMis_ZoneServerTextOutput` lines `~arn <mode> q|s|m|e …` (kind 155, delivered by the native
  ZoneServer handler), built from the fighter queue (`CColosseumFactory+0x2C`, every category, only for the open
  mode), the spectator table, the running matches of the mode (`+0x44`, team vectors, start time `CColosseum+8`) and
  the names (`CExecutionerData+0x0C`); Watch attaches the player to the chosen running match (cap, party rule, not a
  fighter) and sends the native EnterColosseum order for him alone (like the relog). New results 12-15 (match over,
  match full, party member fights there, sent to the match in progress). Generator option `--no-rosters`.
- MissionServer cave grown to 8 KB (0x09120000-0x09121FFF, 5108 bytes used), its state moved to 0x09123000 (claims
  recorded through the ledger).
- DLL plumbing: `utils/servercmd` declares the lines-only word `arn` (no prop_hunt table entry, never sent as a
  command; `check_servercmd.py` refuses such a word if a feature sends it) and gains `eden_servercmd_lines_ready()`
  (the server-line reader is in place): the DLL never asks for a list if a `~arn` line could reach the chat. EDEN
  0.754.0.
- Tests: server emulation 236/236 (+41: list lines, queue categories, closed mode, filtered names, cut at 360
  characters, matches of two modes, offline fighter, Watch found / over / full / party / fighter / queued / attached,
  close releases the watchers, ZoneServer gates and 2 s list gate), `test_arena.py` 37/37, `mempatch_check` 0 error;
  client rosters logic 58/58 and window 37/37 (×2 optimisations), panel previews rendered with the game atlas, map
  pictures and font: readable, nothing cut; spectator logic 111/111, stop 46/46, help 8/8; prop_hunt hub words 69/69.
  Study `docs/studies/arena_rosters.md`.

client.description: Runs many Altar tries from one click, in batches (a button such as 75/200 up to x200), and shows the outcome in a result window stacked like a native window. Batch size adapts to how fast the game keeps up, to avoid freezes, and the server part prevents channel hangs during large simultaneous batches.

/api/features/detail/auto_altar/client?n.changelog:
## [1.12.0] - 2026-10-30 (client 1.12.0, server manifest 1.10.0 unchanged)
- **Tester report: "x200 rolls on the gem altar: the game freezes frames during the roll, before the reward window
  pops up".** Cause: since 1.11.0 the client asked 25 games per request (x200 = 8 requests 250 ms apart). The server
  plays the 25 games in one go and each game sends its native packets (stone paid, reward added to the bag, weekly
  counter, values): a few dozen item and value updates per request reach the client at once. The game runs every
  network command of a frame in ONE task pass (`0xB4EA80`, `docs/studies/equip_smooth.md` section 6), and each item
  update refreshes the bag and the HUD natively: one long frame per request, 8 freezes per x200. Our own work per
  packet is small (the marked result and end packets are only counted and held back).
- **Fix: the batch is paced on the frames it produces.** First request 5 games; after each request the worst frame
  time seen since it was sent (measured per frame, `eden_frame_register`) sets the next size: under 50 ms = twice as
  many (up to 25), 90 ms or more = cut in proportion (25 games and a 250 ms frame -> 5), never under 3; 150 ms
  (was 250 ms) of quiet frames between two requests. A fast PC with the bag closed still plays a x200 in about 10
  requests; a slow PC or an open bag stays at 3-5 games per frame instead of 25. 1.8.0 servers unchanged (first
  request, then the rest in one block). The server is unchanged: one `Flush All` per request (server 1.10.0), at
  most 67 for a x200 instead of 600-800 with native plays.
- **Progress on the button:** `Playing...` becomes `75/200...` (games done / asked), tooltip unchanged. During a batch
  the Play line no longer recomputes the start checks (free slots, stocks, picks) every 300 ms.
- **Probe lines that really reach the log:** the batch load and main-thread block lines used the tag `[auto_altar]`,
  which the log drops while the feature runs at level 1 (default). Now `[altar_probe] batch load: K of N games in R

## [server 1.10.0] - 2026-10-28 (server manifest 1.10.0, client 1.11.5 unchanged)
- **Prod 2026-10-27 19:20 AST: several players ran altar batches at once and every channel froze 15-34 s, then many
  players were disconnected.** Up to 2077 lottery log lines a minute per player (ZAADZ 1503 on Ch4, [GS]joriniron 919
  on Ch1, Alteros 2077 on Ch3), the four ZoneServers and the WorldServer stopped logging at the same seconds (Ch3 too,
  where nobody rolled), the MissionServer kept working: 4981 `DBA :: Flush All` and 1720 lottery-counter updates in
  2 minutes, none in normal play. No crash, no CPU or disk pressure, PostgreSQL without lock errors.
- **Cause (IDA, ZoneServer):** every native lottery update (`CCharacterDBO::Update*Lottery*`, about twenty functions)
  sends its SQL with `CDBAgent::Command` (one network message to the MissionServer) and then a second command
  `"Flush All"` (the literal at `0x088718BF`): one MissionServer commit per update, 3-4 per game.

  once (counted at `0x089CFC64`); any other command runs the moved prologue and goes on at `0x083421B6`. `batch()`
  stores the character DB id (`ch+0x34`) before the first game, clears it after the last one and sends ONE
  `Flush All` (`CDBAgent::Singleton` `0x089BE3D8`): one commit per request (25 games with the 1.11.x client) instead of
  one per update. The SQL commands themselves are unchanged and still sent in order. New `state` claim
  `0x089CFC60-0x089CFC6F` (free page after the `.bss`, ledger line 746).

client.description: Session in one feature, each part switchable in Settings > Features. Connection lost (on by default): when the PC's network drops or the server stops answering in game, a strip mid-screen (and the window title) shows the time waited while the game keeps its connections; when the network comes back the game goes on by itself, nothing is rebuilt. The feature never disconnects you by itself: the strip goes away as soon as data comes back on the game's connections. When the game really loses the session, its disconnect window has a 'Restart game' button that closes the game and opens it again on the login screen. Fast logout (former fast_logout, off by default, kept on for a player who had it): shorter countdown when you go back to character selection or change channel, 3 seconds instead of 10 (part '3-second countdown'; untick it for 5 seconds); same window, Cancel button and protections; the ZoneServer part lowers the server floor to 3 s and a client on a server without it goes back to the native 10 s. Silent relog (part 'Reconnect automatically after a drop'): after a network change in game, the game restarts and quillash back in to the same character by itself, reusing the account and

/api/features/detail/auto_reconnect/clie.changelog:
# auto_reconnect — Changelog

## [1.12.0] - 2026-10-30 — servers stopped or restarting: the game's own close window, no relog
- **Admin request**: after a server restart the silent relog reconnected players without the client update (it starts
  `game_.exe` itself, not the launcher), and a zone shut down must show the game's normal close window.
- **Signal**: at an in-game loss (`HandleNetworkError` type 1/2, before the native handler), one TCP probe of the zone
  endpoint (`[0x10C3D8C]`+0x5A/+0x5E) and of the World endpoint (+0x44/+0x48, layout read in `sub_B60870` /
  `sub_D75BC0`), non-blocking, SYN retries off (`SIO_TCP_INITIAL_RTO`, `TCP_INITIAL_RTO_NO_SYN_RETRANSMISSIONS`), 1.5 s
  budget (2.6 s when the option is refused, Windows then reports a refusal after ~2 s). A refused port = that server
  process is gone (the servers send no shutdown notice: only SIGUSR1 is handled, `restart_safe`/`stop` kill them, the
  kernel closes the listener with the links).
- **Stopped / restarting** (zone or World refused): auto_reconnect steps aside: native handler only, no relog, no
  "Restart game" label, no box/strip/title, close button native; kept until out of the world (no second probe).
- **Servers up** (both answer) or **no answer** (our network): unchanged (silent relog when ready, otherwise the native
  window with Restart game).
- **Log**: one `[ar_loss]` line per loss (tag outside feature names, written at the default level) with both probes,
  the login port (logged only), the time spent and the decision; replaces the `connection lost in game` line.
- Tests: `test_threads` 143 -> 173 (verdict/decision tables, zone stopped, World stopped, parts off, servers up,
  no answer, real loopback probe open/closed); `run_tests.py` source check requires the `[ar_loss]` line.

## [1.11.1] - 2026-10-28 — character password kept across chained relogs, clean stops, honest strip
- **Fix (major): a second network loss in a row lost the character password.** The capture hook skipped every send
  made while a relog job ran, so the relog's own submission was never kept; the next relog stopped at once with
  "none is kept". The capture now runs for every mode-0 send (relog's own submission included) while the `relog`
  part is on, so the password is validated again once back in game and chains like the account password. A code
  6/7/8/9 during the job still wipes it (one try, never a second).
- **Fix: step 3b no longer stalls 150 s.** When the password box is not in mode 0 at submit time (nothing sent), the
  relog now stops at once with `stopped: character password box not ready, enter it by hand` instead of showing
  "Reconnecting... step 3/3" until the window ran out.
- **Fix: capture follows the in-game switch.** No character password is kept when the player has turned off
  "Reconnect automatically after a drop".
- **Fix: no stack bytes copied** after the password into the protected buffer / DPAPI blob (buffer zeroed first).
- **Honest log lines**: "none is kept: stopping at the character password box, nothing sent" (was "before the
  character list"); "the server asked for the character password again after the one try: not sent twice"; the
  relog's own re-capture quillash "character password sent by the silent relog kept again" (length only).
- **Failure strip for a character-password stop**: line 2 reads "Type your character password, or press Restart game"
  (was "Log in again..."), and the strip hides while `Root/CharPasswordDlg` or the native message `Root/DragMsgDlgUI`
  ("Wrong character password") is visible, so it never covers the box. `ar_relog_fail_cpw()` exposes the reason.
  Preview (layout geometry + native `ScreenMessageBG`, FONT01 16 px, text fits):
  `Downloads/assets_wave/_previews_20261028/auto_reconnect/cpw_fail_strip_{1024x768,1920x1080}.png`, tool
  `client/tools/preview_cpw_strip.py`.
- Doc fixes: after a refusal the box is CLOSED by the native OK handler (`sub_9D27E0` closes it, `sub_9D2C00` shows
  message 3445 and re-enables Start Game), it is not "left open"; three functions (not two) were added to the
  exact-bytes head check.
- Tests: `test_relog` 37 -> 60 (hand-off v2 written/claimed only when validated and same charid, chained relog,
  refusal during the relog drops the re-capture, part switch, zeroed tail, codes 7/8/9, asked again after the try,
  box not ready / text refused / no edit box), `test_threads` 138 -> 143 (strip text and hiding). The chained-relog
  tests fail on 1.11.0 (5 failures) and pass on 1.11.1.

## [1.11.0] - 2026-10-27 — silent relog handles a character password (part `relog`)
- **A character with a password now relogs silently too.** Until now the silent relog stopped at the character
  list when the server opened the `CharPasswordDlg` (the player had to type the password). The relog now reuses the
  character password the player entered in this session, the same way it reuses the account password.
- **Capture** (source session): a 5-byte inline hook on the character-password send `sub_6D72D0` (prologue checked,
  12 bytes) reads the bytes sent only for dialog mode 0 (entering the existing password, `[dlg+0x104]==0`),
  never for mode 1/2/3 (set/confirm a new password). The value is kept `CryptProtectMemory`-protected with the
  character id and is never logged (length only). It is validated (kept for a relog) only once the character is in
  game (FSM >= 7) with no wrong-password reply (code 6) seen in between; wiped on the login screen.
- **Hand-off**: the validated character password is added to the existing DPAPI hand-off blob (same user scope, same
  2-minute TTL, same character id check), never in clear on disk.
- **Relog step 3b**: a 5-byte inline hook on `CUICharPasswordDlg` mode dispatch `sub_9D2340` watches the server
  codes. When the server asks for the character password (code 0) and one is kept, the relog puts it in the dialog's
  EditBox (`[dlg+0xDC]`) and calls the native OK handler `sub_9D27E0` **once** on the main thread

The login is kept encrypted in memory and handed over encrypted (DPAPI, 2 minutes), never written in clear.
parts.label: Reconnect automatically after a drop

Relog fails cleanly: change your account password, then switch network -> the relog cannot finish; a box 'Automatic reconnection failed' with 'Restart game' shows, never two boxes on top of each other.

Relog option off: Settings > Features, under Auto Reconnect untick 'Reconnect automatically after a drop' -> switch network -> no relog by itself; the disconnect popup with 'Restart game' shows.

Logout cancelled: Fast logout on, start a logout -> move during the countdown -> it is cancelled. Start again and press Cancel -> you stay in game.
DEV only: log in once this session with your REAL account password (the DEV accepts a wrong one, but then the network-switch relog fails with 'Incorrect username or password').
No game popup during relog: switch network -> while 'Reconnecting... step x/3' shows, no game popup appears (no 'This account is being used.', no server busy, no Confirm to press).

Relog gives up: switch network, then cut the network again during the strip until it gives up -> box 'Automatic reconnection failed' with 'Restart game' -> press it -> game reopens on the login screen.
Restart game: after a long cut with the 'Connection to the server lost' box, press 'Restart game' -> the game closes and opens again on the login screen, only one game window.

Password rules: 'Set password' at character select -> type 5 or 7 characters, or a symbol -> the game refuses it ('Password must be no longer than 6 chars' / 'Password Cannot Contain Symbols').
Two relogs in a row: protected character with its password typed -> switch network, let it come back, wait 5 s, switch network again -> both relogs end in game with no typing.
Typo then right password: at Start Game type a wrong character password once ('Wrong character password'), then the right one, enter, switch network -> back in game without typing.
Character without password: normal character -> switch network -> 'Reconnecting... step 1/3 .. 3/3' then in game, no password step.

Password box not typed: protected character that entered without asking this session -> switch network -> stops at the password box; after Cancel: 'Type your character password, or press Restart game'.
Strip off: Settings > Features, under Auto Reconnect untick 'Connection lost countdown' -> unplug the cable 20 s -> no strip shows; the game still goes on when the network comes back.
Whole feature off: untick Auto Reconnect in Settings > Features -> a long cut ends with the game's normal disconnect window, as in the normal game. Tick it again -> strip and relog are back.
Party after a relog: in a party, switch network -> after the relog you are still in the party and the others see your HP bar and position again.
Relog during a fight: switch network while a monster attacks you -> after the relog you are on the same map, alive or dead as the server says, with no item lost.
Options kept: under Auto Reconnect untick 'Connection lost countdown' and tick 'Fast logout' -> close and restart the game -> both options are as you set them.
Others see you back: a friend stands next to you -> switch network -> after the relog he sees you again at the same place.
Guild chat after a relog: switch network, let it come back -> type a line in guild chat -> guild members get it.

client.description: Named field bosses of every open-world map (the red <Title> Name bosses with a long respawn, like <Desert Eagle> Guff in The Battle of Time and Space) of your channel are shown where they spawn, on the minimap and on the map (M): a red icon when the boss is alive, grey with the countdown to its respawn when it is dead, gold when the respawn is due, blue when it is not up yet since the server started. On the map (M) the icon has 'Name - 12:34' (or Alive, Due, Not up) under it; on the minimap a dead boss has its countdown under its icon; hover any icon for the name, title, level, map and time. /api/features/detail/boss_timers/client?.changelog:
# boss_timers — CHANGELOG

## client 0.6.4 (2026-11-15) - the boss icon stays on the minimap after any click on the radar
- Admin report (Devastation Realm, X:364 Y:468, capture `docs/studies/boss_timers/admin_1115_minimap.png`): the map (M) shows 'Possessed Ladon - Alive' right next to the player, the minimap shows nothing. Same as marlowmoss's earlier reports ("the icon disappears after zooming"). Not a position problem: the boss is 21 units west of the player, inside the minimap at every zoom.
- Cause (proved in game_.exe): the icon layer was a child of `Root/Radar`, next to `Root/Radar/BG`, the window that holds the map image (`BG/mapFrame/mapImage`) and the radar frame and buttons (`BG/BackGrand`). A left click anywhere on the radar (+/- zoom, the globe that opens the map, the mail or hide button, the map itself) runs `Window::onMouseButtonDown` (0xB803F0) -> `moveToFront_impl(true)` (0xB8C030), which first raises every parent: `Root/Radar/BG` moves to the end of `Root/Radar`'s draw list (`addWindowToDrawList` 0xB8AC40, behind the AlwaysOnTop windows only), so the opaque minimap texture was drawn over our icons. The 0.6.1 / 0.6.3 fixes (layer made visible again, icons pinned) could not help: the icons were there, under the map.
- Fix: the layer is now `Root/Radar/mapFrame/EdenBtMap`, a child of the native `mapFrame`, `AlwaysOnTop` among `mapFrame`'s children only: always over the map image whatever is clicked, still under the radar frame, its buttons and the player arrow (clicks keep reaching the buttons). Entry added to `client_dll/tools/always_on_top_allow.json` (`mm_layer`).
- Pinned icons (out of range, or under a radar button) now stay in the band left free by the native buttons: between the bottom of `BackGrand/mailBtn` and the top of `BackGrand/BattleBtn`, read from the native rects (28..128 of the 154 px map with the stock layout); tooltip 'At the minimap edge, to the <dir>' when the boss is inside the frame but under a button, 'Beyond the minimap' when it is out of it.
- Minimap timer: a dead boss shows the same countdown as the map (M) under its icon (`12:34`, `~12:34`, `Due`), a Treasure Goblin its time left; small font with a dark shadow; alive / not up / event bosses: icon only.
- Position re-proved against the game: `sub_7EF8F0` cuts the `miniMap` texture around (player + 100, map height - player + 100) at `mapFrame` size / zoom, so a world point is at `centre + (boss - player) x zoom`, north up. Zoom levels from the game constants: start 1.3 (`sub_7F6AA0`), x1.5 up to 1.3, x2/3 down to 0.4 (`sub_7F4190`) = 1.3, 0.867, 0.578, 0.385.
- Tests: client 177 x2 (bench of 7 places on 4 maps x the 4 game zoom levels against an emulation of `sub_7EF8F0`, worst gap 0.0001 px; z-order model of `moveToFront_impl` / `addWindowToDrawList`: the 0.6.3 parenting is hidden by a click on +/-, the 0.6.4 one stays over the map and under the buttons after any click; band, label, timer), game_.exe constants and `moveToFront_impl` bytes, radar tree of `RadarUI_Ver2.layout`. Preview: `docs/studies/boss_timers/preview_minimap_0.6.4.png` (`client/tools/preview_minimap.py`).

## client 0.6.3 (2026-11-13) - every boss of your map on the minimap, pinned to the edge when far
- Tester report (marlowmoss, Witchcraft Forest, X:217 Y:513): the map (M) shows 'Holy Scourge - Alive' but the minimap shows no icon. Cause: the minimap layer only drew a boss inside the area the minimap covers (`centre + (boss - player) x scale`, icon hidden when outside the frame); only the Treasure Goblin was pinned on the edge (0.6.2). Holy Scourge spawns at (195, 397), about 118 units south of the player: outside the minimap at the usual zoom, so hidden. Same window, same list (`bt_spots`, map of the player), same coordinates as the map (M): nothing else differs.
- Every spot of your map (bosses, shared places, goblins) out of range is now pinned on the minimap edge (ellipse) in its direction, faded (alpha 0.72); back at full alpha and at its real place once in range. Only the bosses of the map you stand on, one icon per place (no extra load).
- Tooltip of a pinned icon: the usual state (Alive, Dead - respawn in ..., Due, Not up, Event) plus 'Beyond the minimap, to the south' (8 directions, `bt_dir8`, refreshed every 250 ms).
- Help: one paragraph on the pinned icons.
- Tests: client 120 x2 (Holy Scourge case from X:217 Y:513, zoom, directions, far tooltip) + source check (pin for every kind, alpha, far tooltip).

## client 0.6.2 / catalogue (2026-11-12) - Legion cooldowns on every map, Treasure Goblin pinned to the minimap edge
- Tester report "Legions cooldown are not showing on some maps". Cause (server scenes read on the DEV): the 77 `<Legion Elite>` monsters respawn every 120 s on 15 open-world maps (Goss Mountains, Beluga Bay, Wetlands, Valley of Kings, Avila Volcano, Golden Plains, Arid Wilds, Delphi Forest, Blackflame Peak, Death Valley, Tempest Cliff, Searing Valley, Devastation Realm, Ethereal Dome, Meeryasha) and only on 4 maps (Decay Swamp, Highlands, Witchcraft Forest, Shiver Peak) at 1200 s; the catalogue generator kept only respawn >= 600 s, so the 15 maps had no Legion at all. `gen_bosses.py`: a `Legion Elite` boss is kept from 60 s (MIN_LEGION_DELAY). `bosses.json` 95 -> 153 bosses (+58 Legions, 3 or 4 per map). The ZoneServer manifest already writes born/die for every `<` titled monster (0.4.0), nothing to change there. Instanced copies (Rose Temple 211/648/817, battlefield S224 'Polymer Being Legion') stay out on purpose.
- DLL list capacity BT_MAX 160 -> 256 (153 bosses + up to 15 goblins did not fit).
- Tester report "Goblin: icon doesn't appear in minimap". The goblin is announced anywhere on the map, but the minimap only covers a small area around the player: the icon was computed outside the frame and hidden. A Treasure Goblin out of the minimap range is now pinned on the edge of the minimap (ellipse) in the direction where it runs (`bt_mm_pin`); bosses keep the old behaviour (hidden out of range).

checklist.item: Map icons: in Shiver Peak, Witchcraft Forest or The Battle of Time and Space open the map (M) -> an icon at each boss place with 'Name - ...' under it; a shared place has ONE icon 'Name +2 - ...'.
Map help: click the '?' on the map window -> the Boss Timers help explains the colours and the event bosses.
Timer boss tooltip: hover a timer boss icon on the map (M) -> 'Level N field boss - <map>' and its state (Alive, Dead - respawn in ..., or Not up yet). No line is cut.

Event boss tooltip: hover an event boss icon (Rax'zor, Ful'gorath, Polus...) -> 'Level 65 event boss', 'Not seen since the server started' (never 'Alive' while absent) and what makes it appear, when known.
Shared place: hover an icon with '+2' -> the other bosses are listed under 'Also at this place:'.
Minimap: walk near a boss place -> its icon shows on the minimap at the right spot and moves when you walk; when you are far it waits on the minimap edge, faded, on the side where the boss is.
Minimap zoom: near a boss place zoom the minimap in and out -> the icon stays on the boss place.

Minimap far boss (0.6.3): in Witchcraft Forest stand at X:217 Y:513 -> Holy Scourge shows as a faded icon on the bottom edge of the minimap; hover it -> its state ('Alive' or 'Dead - respawn in ...') and 'Beyond the minimap, to the south'; walk south -> the icon leaves the edge and sits on the boss place at full colour. Only the bosses of Witchcraft Forest are on the edge.
Boss death: kill a timer boss (Guff, Sam, Sonyay) or watch it die -> within a few seconds its icon turns grey and the map shows a countdown that goes down every second.
Event boss death: an event boss dies -> it shows 'Dead' with no countdown.
Respawn: when a timer boss spawns again -> its icon turns red ('Alive') without relogging.
Due: when a respawn time is over but the boss is not up yet -> its icon turns gold with 'Due'.
Not up: after a server restart, a boss that has not spawned yet -> blue icon with 'Not up'.
/bt: type /bt -> the chat lists the bosses of your map only (event bosses never seen in one line) and one line about the other maps; no 'Command Error'.
/bt all: type /bt all -> every map with its bosses is listed.
/bt without boss: on a map with no field boss (for example Aven) type /bt -> 'Boss Timers: no field boss on this map.'
Channel change: change channel or relog -> the icons come back within a few seconds with the states of the new channel; no line starting with '~bt' in the chat.
Channels apart: a boss dies on channel 1 -> go to channel 2 -> channel 2 shows its own state for that boss.
Two players: two players on the same map and channel -> they see the same state and countdown for each boss.
Minimap option: untick 'Boss timers on the minimap' in Settings > Features -> minimap icons vanish, the map (M) keeps them; tick -> they come back.
Map option: untick 'Boss timers on the map (M)' -> the map icons and the '?' vanish; tick -> they come back.
Boss Timers off: untick Boss Timers in Settings > Features -> everything vanishes at once; tick -> everything comes back without relogging.
Screen reset: press Alt+Enter (or change the resolution), then log out to the character screen -> no boss icon or text stays on the login or character screens; icons come back in the world.
Treasure Goblin icon: a Treasure Goblin appears on your map -> red icon where it runs, 'Treasure Goblin - 4:59' under it on the map (M), counting down.
Goblin tooltip: hover the goblin icon -> 'Roaming monster - <map>' and 'Here for m:ss more, then it vanishes with its loot'.
Goblin gone: kill the goblin -> its icon goes away at once. A goblin nobody kills -> its icon goes away when its time is up.
/bt and the goblin: on a map with a goblin type /bt -> 'Treasure Goblin: here for m:ss more, then it vanishes with its loot (it runs: catch it).'
Learned times: an event boss seen respawning at least twice -> its time shows with '~', and 'Maybe back' instead of 'Due'.
Off from the start: start the game with 'Boss Timers' unticked in Settings > Features -> no boss icon on the minimap or on the map (M), and no '?' on the map.
Alive tooltip: hover a red timer boss icon on the map (M) -> it reads 'Alive (up for m:ss)'.
Event boss alive: an event boss is summoned on your map -> its icon turns red and its tooltip reads 'Alive (spawned m:ss ago)'.
/bt all header: type /bt all -> the first line reads 'Boss Timers: N field bosses on this channel.'
/bt other maps: type /bt on a map with field bosses -> the last line reads 'Other maps: N field bosses, M alive. Type /bt all for every map.'
Goblins in /bt all: a Treasure Goblin is up on any map of your channel -> /bt all lists 'Treasure Goblins on this channel: <map> m:ss.'
Countdown after a relog: a timer boss dies, log out and back in 2 minutes later -> its countdown is about 2 minutes lower, not restarted.
Death seen from afar: stay on another map while a boss dies on your channel, then come back -> its icon is grey with the right countdown.

Every world boss: in Limestone Mtn., Tranquil Hill, Golden Plains or any map with a 'Possessed ...' or 'Corrupted ...' boss, open the map (M) -> its icon says 'Alive' (red) after a server start, not 'Not up'.
Every world boss, kill: kill a 'Possessed ...' world boss (or an Executor in Vingot Lab) -> its icon turns grey with the respawn countdown within a second, on the map (M) and the minimap.
No restart needed: log in, teleport to another map, open the map (M) -> the boss icons of that map are there without restarting the game.
No restart needed after a service restart: stay logged in while the admin restarts eden-bosstimers, then kill a boss -> its icon still changes (the service kept your session).
Readable labels: in Vingot Lab open the map (M) -> no text is written over another text or over an icon; bosses very close together share one icon with one line per boss.
Readable labels, size: resize or zoom the map window -> the labels are laid out again and stay readable.

Channel change: change channel or relog -> the icons come back within a few seconds with the states of the new channel; no line starting with '~bt' in the chat.
Channels apart: a boss dies on channel 1 -> go to channel 2 -> channel 2 shows its own state for that boss.
Two players: two players on the same map and channel -> they see the same state and countdown for each boss.
Minimap option: untick 'Boss timers on the minimap' in Settings > Features -> minimap icons vanish, the map (M) keeps them; tick -> they come back.
Map option: untick 'Boss timers on the map (M)' -> the map icons and the '?' vanish; tick -> they come back.
Boss Timers off: untick Boss Timers in Settings > Features -> everything vanishes at once; tick -> everything comes back without relogging.
Screen reset: press Alt+Enter (or change the resolution), then log out to the character screen -> no boss icon or text stays on the login or character screens; icons come back in the world.
Treasure Goblin icon: a Treasure Goblin appears on your map -> red icon where it runs, 'Treasure Goblin - 4:59' under it on the map (M), counting down.
Goblin tooltip: hover the goblin icon -> 'Roaming monster - <map>' and 'Here for m:ss more, then it vanishes with its loot'.
Goblin gone: kill the goblin -> its icon goes away at once. A goblin nobody kills -> its icon goes away when its time is up.
/bt and the goblin: on a map with a goblin type /bt -> 'Treasure Goblin: here for m:ss more, then it vanishes with its loot (it runs: catch it).'
Learned times: an event boss seen respawning at least twice -> its time shows with '~', and 'Maybe back' instead of 'Due'.
Off from the start: start the game with 'Boss Timers' unticked in Settings > Features -> no boss icon on the minimap or on the map (M), and no '?' on the map.
Alive tooltip: hover a red timer boss icon on the map (M) -> it reads 'Alive (up for m:ss)'.
Event boss alive: an event boss is summoned on your map -> its icon turns red and its tooltip reads 'Alive (spawned m:ss ago)'.
/bt all header: type /bt all -> the first line reads 'Boss Timers: N field bosses on this channel.'
/bt other maps: type /bt on a map with field bosses -> the last line reads 'Other maps: N field bosses, M alive. Type /bt all for every map.'
Goblins in /bt all: a Treasure Goblin is up on any map of your channel -> /bt all lists 'Treasure Goblins on this channel: <map> m:ss.'
Countdown after a relog: a timer boss dies, log out and back in 2 minutes later -> its countdown is about 2 minutes lower, not restarted.
Death seen from afar: stay on another map while a boss dies on your channel, then come back -> its icon is grey with the right countdown.

Every world boss: in Limestone Mtn., Tranquil Hill, Golden Plains or any map with a 'Possessed ...' or 'Corrupted ...' boss, open the map (M) -> its icon says 'Alive' (red) after a server start, not 'Not up'.

/api/features/detail/btn_max/client?nowa.changelog:
# btn_max — Changelog

## [1.2.5] - 2026-10-26
- Other game build (S3): the four CEGUI hooks (setEnabled / setVisible / setID 9 bytes `55 8B EC 64 A1 00 00 00 00`,
  subscribeEvent 5 bytes `55 8B EC 6A FF`) checked only `55 8B EC`; they now check every byte they move
  (`eden_install_inline_hook_verified`). A mismatch keeps the all-or-nothing rule: hooks already laid removed, Max
  button off, one `[feature_init]` line.
- Audit S1/S2/S4 (no code change): the prod CDN `SlotSkill.layout` is ours; an original layout without `MaxBtn` makes
  the first mirror call of each list throw inside the guard, that list owner is skipped from then on (native Level Up
  button untouched). The DLL cannot tell whether the ZoneServer has the opcode 623 cave (no answer, no capability):
  see STATUS.
- Tests: 52/52 (bytes of the 4 hooks, other bytes at setID = 2 hooks removed and Max off).

## [1.2.4] - 2026-10-22
- Turning btn_max off then on with the class skill menu open now brings the Max buttons back at once (they stayed hidden
  and disabled until a page change, see 1.2.3). The last Visible/Enabled state of each skill row's Level Up button is
  kept (64 rows at most, cleared on Game Reset); on the off-to-on switch (checked every 250 ms on the game window
  thread) the Max buttons get that state back. A row whose window was replaced is skipped.
- Tests: 50/50 (new: off then on restores Visible and Enabled without a page change, a disabled Level Up keeps Max
  disabled, no replay while on or during a teardown, bounded table, Game Reset clears it).

## 2026-10-21 - no new version: changelog order
- [1.2.2] and [1.2.3] were at the bottom of this file: put back newest first. No shipped file changed.

## [1.2.3] - 2026-10-11
- Note: after re-enabling, the Max buttons reappear on the next class-menu refresh (page change) - the rows are rebuilt by the game.

## [1.2.2] - 2026-10-10
- Hot toggle: when the feature is off, the Max buttons from the SlotSkill layout are force-hidden by the visibility mirror (they are recreated by the game on every class-menu open, so hiding once was not enough); the max-skill send is also gated.

## 2026-10-10 - no new version: Max buttons hidden when btn_max is off (fixed in the core, EDEN 0.107.0)
- With btn_max=0 every skill row still showed a dead "Max" button. The native list clones the row template of
  `SlotSkill.layout` once per spell (`sub_A10C20` -> `sub_A12D80`) and inserts a counter before the last segment
  (`CommonSkillSlotSkill/Item/7/MaxBtn`); `utils/feature_ui` only matched the template (`*SlotSkill/Item/MaxBtn`).
  It now hides the template and every per-row copy (hidden = not clickable). btn_max code unchanged.

## [1.2.1] - 2026-10-09 - server: opcode 623 applies the guards of the native SetSpellLevel
- Security (server audit 2026-10-09): the cave handler of opcode 623 skipped the checks that the native +1
  (`CSpellMasterFactory::SetSpellLevel` 0x08156280) makes, so a modified client sending 623 could raise a spell it
  owns past what the game allows. It now applies the same guards, in the same order, and pays only what it writes:
  - spell flagged `SSpellData+0x12 & 0x20` or of type 7: nothing done, no text (native: silent);
  - `SSpellData::CheckClass(sd, character+0x47C)` (0x084EE000) false - a spell of another class: nothing done, no
    text (native: silent);
  - global cap `AllFormulaParas+0x908` (S_Parameter 578), or `+0x910` (580) for a type 6 spell when the class is
    not its class group (`CCharacter::GetClassGroup` 0x0840A0F0), then the class level (`+0x47E`, type 6) or the
    character level (`+0x470`): text 2012 when not even one level fits;
  - cost row looked up by EXACT level (the old lookup took the next row up when a level was missing): text 1448
    with the spell id when missing, like an unknown spell template;
  - cost type other than 1 (gold) or 9 (NP): refused with text 1791, nothing debited (the old cave took NP);
  - not enough gold/NP for the next level: text 1791;
  - cost per level computed like the native (single-precision SSE products, `cvtss2si` = rounding to nearest; the
    old cave truncated in x87 extended precision and charged up to 1 less per level);
  - linked spell (`CSpellMaster+0x24` non-zero): the base spell is raised, like the native
    `CNE_CZ_ZoneServerUseSkillPoint::Execute` (0x0829D470).
  The texts go through the character's own `TextOutputIndex` (vtable +0x58) with the native arguments
  (1448/-102/"%d", 2012 and 1791/-105/""). When at least one level is gained nothing is printed (unchanged).
- Side effect fixed: the old cave debited gold/NP BEFORE `SetSpellLevelForce`, which then refused silently above the
  global cap, for type 7 or for flagged spells - the player paid and kept his level. Every refusal is now decided
  before the debit.
- No more log line per request (`/tmp/zs_skillmax.log` was opened/written/closed by every 623/621/622 packet,
  disk-filling by a spamming client); the boot registration still quillash once.
- Cave rebuilt with the Linux toolchain (`gen_mempatch.py --build --host eden-dev`, gcc 11.4 `-m32` + ld 2.38
  `elf_i386`, only a `/tmp/btnmax_build_<stamp>` folder used, then removed); `--build --check` rebuilds and compares
  (identical). 3136 bytes at `0x08B70000` (segment still `0x1000`), `cave_trampoline 0x08B70640`,
  `cave_register 0x08B70670`, chain slot `0x08B70B44`. Manifest 1.2.1: same site `0x0818886E`, same segment.
- `deploy.py` 1.2.1 recognises the previous cave (`zs_skillmax_cave.v120.cave.bin/.json`, kept): `status` says
  `older` / `partial`, the prod (LIEF) deploy refuses to stack the new cave on it (Revert, then Deploy), `revert`
  removes it like the current one.
- Tests: `server/test_cave_emu.py --zs <vanilla>` 27/27 (new: 23 scenarios, each run against the native
  `Execute`+`SetSpellLevel` repeated until it stops, same final level, same gold/NP, same refusal text; the v1.2.0
  cave diverges in 16 of them), `server/test_mempatch.py` 27/27, `server/test_deploy_revert.py`

checklist.item: Setup: a character with unspent skill points -> open the skill window (K).
Max like +1: in the skill window, on every row the Max button is available, greyed out or hidden exactly like the +1 button next to it.
Max in one click: click Max on a skill -> it goes as high as your points allow in one click, and the points spent match the levels gained.
Then +1: after using Max on one skill, click +1 on another skill -> it goes up by one level only.
Gold skill: on a spell paid with gold, several levels below your level, click Max -> it reaches your level in one click and the gold spent equals all the +1 costs added up.
Not enough gold: with less gold than the next level costs, click Max -> nothing changes and the same 'not enough' message as the +1 button shows.
At the cap: on a skill already at its cap, click Max -> the same 'level limit' message as the +1 button shows and nothing is spent.
Feature off: Settings > Features, untick Btn Max -> the Max button disappears from every row (common and class tabs) and +1 still works. Tick it -> Max is back at once, no restart.
Kept after relog: click Max on a skill, then relog and change channel -> the skill keeps its new level and your points stay spent.
Spam Max: click Max many times fast on one skill -> it stops at the max, no extra points or gold are taken.
Both tabs: use Max on a skill in the common tab and on one in the class tab -> both work the same way.
Back on with window open: skill window open, turn Btn Max off then on -> the Max buttons come back at once, without changing page.
Skill works: after Max, use that skill in a fight -> it has the damage and effects of its new level, as if raised with +1.
Off kept after relog: untick Btn Max in Settings > Features -> relog -> open the skill window (K) -> still no Max button.
One point left: with only 1 skill point, click Max on a skill -> it goes up by one level only and you have 0 points left.
