## [0.19.0] - 2026-11-05 — system features shown with their state, not toggleable
- Admin request 2026-11-05: a system feature (registry.c `configurable 0`) is listed in the Features tab as a
  greyed, ticked-or-not checkbox `<Name>  v<version>   (system, always on)` or `(system, off in this build)`, from
  `eden_feature_is_enabled`. The player cannot change it: the box is `Disabled`, a click redraws the row, and
  Enable all / Disable all, the pending queue and the restart count skip it. Its parts stay normal checkboxes.
  The row also shows when a DLL ships with the feature turned off in its registry row.
- `turtle_race` left `k_hidden`: like the other races and accessory_slot it now shows its state. Protections
  (crash_guard, crash_reporter, shader_guard, cegui_null_guard) and private `_` features stay hidden.

  grimoire, legendary_achievements, perf_hud, perf_tune were missing). The list stays a ScrollablePane with one
  checkbox per row (search, Enable shown / Disable shown and the ink pass all walk `g_n`), so no other change.

  disablable). With registry.c `configurable 0` (enabled 1) and its 4 part rows removed, neither eden_patch.ini,

  game after a graphics profile saved under Vulkan, and after a Vulkan on / off switch). Settings > Features unchanged.
## [0.16.0] - 2026-10-30 — features=0 can no longer hide the Features tab; diagnostics always in the log
- Player reports (Settings > Features missing or "not activated" on DLL 0.658): `eden_user.ini [feature_settings]
  features=0` (written by the 17-19/10 test DLLs or by the tool's part toggle) removed the Features tab, the only
  in-game place to turn it back on (feature_settings hides itself from its own list). While feature_settings is on,
  `features=0` is now ignored: the line is reset to the default (1, key removed from eden_user.ini) and the tab is
  built. One line at log level 1: `[fsettings] init v0.16.0: eden_user.ini had [feature_settings] features=0 ...`.

checklist.item: Open Settings: a new Features tab is there.
Features list: open Settings > Features -> each Eden feature has a tick box with its name and version; there is no line for the crash guard, the crash reporter or the shader guard.
Restart, Cancel: at the bottom of Settings > Features press 'Restart this client' -> it asks 'Restart now?' with 'Yes, restart' and 'Cancel' -> press Cancel: nothing happens, you keep playing.
Yes, restart: press 'Restart this client', then 'Yes, restart' -> the game closes and opens again by itself on the login screen, and your Settings > Features choices are kept.
Shared key tooltip: Settings > Hotkeys > Eden Reforged -> hover a key marked '(game too)' -> the tooltip names the game hotkey that also uses it and says both actions run.

Hotkeys tabs: open Settings > Hotkeys -> it has two tabs, 'Game' and 'Eden Reforged' -> 'Eden Reforged' shows one line per shortcut, action on the left, key on the right (e.g. 'Repair all gear' = 'F5 (game too)').
Shared key tooltip: Settings > Hotkeys > Eden Reforged -> hover a key marked '(game too)' -> the tooltip names the game hotkey that also uses it and says both actions run.
Picking a key: Settings > Hotkeys > Eden Reforged -> click the key of 'Bulk Use window' -> the note says 'Press the new hotkey.' and game keys (I, C, M) open nothing while it waits.
Letter alone refused: click an Eden Reforged key and press B alone (or Space, or a digit) -> refused, the note says letters, digits, Space and symbols need Ctrl or Alt.
Key taken from another line: set 'Auto sell: mark' to F11 -> its line says the key was taken from 'Multi delete: mark', which now shows None.
No key: Settings > Hotkeys > Eden Reforged -> click a key and press Backspace (or Delete) -> it shows None.
Default: change two Eden Reforged keys, then press Default on the Hotkeys tab -> every Eden Reforged line is back to its default key and the game lines are reset as before. Press Confirm to keep it.
Key kept after restart: change an Eden Reforged key, press Confirm, quit and start the game again -> the new key is still set and still works.
Feature off hides its keys: in Settings > Features untick 'Repair All Btn' -> its lines ('Repair all gear' and the others) leave Settings > Hotkeys > Eden Reforged. Tick it: they come back.
No freeze during a key pick: click an Eden Reforged key, then switch tab, close Settings or change zone before pressing a key -> no freeze or crash, and I, C, M work again afterwards.
Feature off at once: in Settings > Features untick a feature -> it turns off at once (a line marked 'needs a restart' waits for 'Restart this client'). Tick it again: it is back.
Esc during a key pick: Settings > Hotkeys > Eden Reforged -> click a key, then press Esc -> only the pick is cancelled, Settings stays open with your other changes. Press Esc again: Settings closes.
Esc with Messages open: open the Messages window, then Settings > Hotkeys > Eden Reforged and click a key -> press Esc -> only the pick is cancelled (old key kept); Messages and Settings stay open.
Tabs after restarts: quit and start the game 3 times -> each time Settings has the Features tab, and Settings > Hotkeys has its 'Eden Reforged' tab.

Enable / Disable buttons: Settings > Features with an empty search bar shows 'Enable all' and 'Disable all' -> type a word in 'Search features...' -> they turn into 'Enable shown' and 'Disable shown'.
No match: type a word that matches nothing in 'Search features...' -> 'No match' shows. Press Esc in the bar (or its clear button): the search empties, every line is back and the list is at the top.

Disable shown: type 'firework' in 'Search features...' -> only the matching lines stay -> press 'Disable shown': only those lines are unticked, the others do not change. 'Enable shown' ticks them back.
Disable all / Enable all: press 'Disable all', then 'Enable all' -> every feature turns off, then on again; the game keeps running, and the note at the bottom says how many were saved and applied.
Saved note: tick or untick one line in Settings > Features -> the note at the bottom says 'Saved and applied.', or 'Saved. This one needs a restart.' with the button 'Restart this client (needed)'.
Untick kept after restart: untick a feature, quit the game normally and start it again -> the feature is still unticked and still off. Tick it again: it works again.
Search hotkeys: Settings > Hotkeys > Eden Reforged -> type F5 in 'Search hotkeys...' -> only lines using F5 stay. Type part of an action name: only that action stays. Esc empties the search.
Typing in a search bar: type I, C, M, B in 'Search features...' or 'Search hotkeys...' -> they only go into the bar, no window opens. After leaving the bar, these keys open their windows again.
Tooltips readable: hover the Eden Reforged hotkeys and the Settings > Features lines that have a tooltip -> every tooltip can be read in full, nothing is cut on the right side.
Cancel a key change: change a key in Settings > Hotkeys > Eden Reforged, then press Cancel (or close Settings with its cross) -> reopen it: the old key is shown and still works.
Two game windows: on the same PC, use 'Restart this client' then 'Yes, restart' in one of them -> only that one closes and opens again, the other keeps playing.
Login after restart: after 'Yes, restart' -> the login screen opens with your account name already filled in; you only type your password (it was not kept).
Restart in the world: use 'Restart this client' while in the world and log back in -> your character is where you left it, with the same items, gold and party as before.
Window closed with its feature: open the Bulk Use window, then untick 'Bulk use' in Settings > Features -> the window closes at once, the game keeps running; ticking it again brings it back.
Small window: play in a 1024x768 game window -> in Settings > Features every line and the 'Restart this client' button can be reached with the scroll bar, nothing overlaps.
Game tab unchanged: Settings > Hotkeys > Game -> the game's own hotkey list shows and its keys can be changed as before.
Game key refused: click an Eden Reforged key and press F6 -> refused, the note names the game hotkey that already uses F6.
Ctrl+1 refused: click an Eden Reforged key and press Ctrl+1 -> refused, it is already a game hotkey.
Cancel after a move: after setting 'Auto sell: mark' to F11, press Cancel -> reopen Settings > Hotkeys > Eden Reforged: 'Multi delete: mark' is still F11 and 'Auto sell: mark' None.
Pick abandoned: click an Eden Reforged key, then press Esc, click elsewhere or wait 15 s -> the key stays as it was.
Bulk Use on Ctrl+B: set 'Bulk Use window' to Ctrl+B and press Confirm -> in the world Ctrl+B opens and closes the Bulk Use window, F9 no longer does.
Search features: type part of a feature name in 'Search features...' -> only the matching lines stay; erase the text -> every line is back.
Channel change: untick two features in Settings > Features, then change channel -> after the loading, both are still unticked and still off.
Other character: change an Eden Reforged key, go to character select and play another character -> the new key is set and works for him too.
Game keys after Settings: use Settings > Features and Settings > Hotkeys, then close Settings -> the game keys (I bag, C character, M map) all work as before.

# gear_swap — Changelog

## [2.7.5] - 2026-10-26 - client: presets 4-12 only when the preset buffer code is the expected one
- Asset / site audit for the prod release. Layouts: the prod CDN EquipmentWndSwitch / MiniInfoWnd_EquipmentSwitch are
  identical to ours, and ours are the game's own (12 slots and switch01..switch012 are in the original layouts, the
  HUD constructor `sub_7D6590` checks each `switch0N` with isWindowPresent before binding it); angeljob04..012.dds are
  on the CDN.
- Other game build (S3): `gs_swap_start` called the preset buffer getter `0x6A0AA0` and the allocator `0x4012E0` and
  replaced the buffer pointer `0x105FC1C` without checking any byte, after byte patches (`setidx`, `collidx`) that
  index the buffer up to page 11. The getter (32 bytes, holding the `0x105FC1C` address), the allocator head and the
  size push `68 40|60 04 00 00` are now checked first (a detour by another feature accepted); not recognised = nothing
  written, presets 4-12 off, HUD buttons 4-12 hidden like the part switched off, one `[feature_init]` line. If the
  buffer could not be grown, the byte patches already written are put back (a 0x440 buffer indexed up to page 11
  would be written past its end) and the part stays off.
- Tests: client 135/135 (+7: sites accepted / refused, size push 0x440 or 0x460, nothing written on another build,
  HUD 4-12 hidden).

## [2.7.4] - 2026-10-22 - client: the Character Info perf probe stops once its 18 windows are used, and is cheap while it runs
- `gsp_beat` looked up `CharacterWnd_new2` and `EquipmentWnd_new2` by name every 250 ms for the whole session, even
  after the 18 measurement windows were used, because `gsp_probe_due` ignored the report count. The probe is now never
  due once the budget is used and the sampler is stopped (it still runs while armed, to see the close).
- While it runs, both dialogs are read through cached handles (checked with `IsBadReadPtr` + the vtable seen at lookup);

## [server 2.3.0] - 2026-10-22 - Switch after a backpack sort: every preset item is found by uid (memory only)
Admin report (DEV, [CM]quillash, DLL 0.541.0, accessory_slot 0.8.6 / server manifests accessory_slot 0.8.4 + gear_swap
2.2.0): "Backpack sorting complete", then Switch on preset 1: "(Transcendent) equipment does not exist",
"equipment does not exist" (the bracelet, its S_Item name is Big5 and shows empty), then the Switch cooldown.
- Cause (ZoneServer, proven on the vanilla 48dc3873 and on the DEV database): a preset row stores the backpack
  LOCATION of its item (con 0, slot, page). `CItemFactory::ArrangeItemInv` @0x08095DE0 (backpack sort) moves the
  items with `IItemContainer::PutIn` and never touches the presets (no call to `UpdateFastDressFromInfo`, which only
  runs on equip, unequip, `SwitchContainerItem`, archive put / get and destroy). `ApplyFastDress` @0x08124F00 then
  checks a backpack row inline at the saved place (0x0812655D-0x08126639: page key `[row+0x10]`, slot `[row+0xC]`,
  uid and item id must match) and sends 6480 "%s equipment does not exist" (0x0812662B) when the item moved. DEV rows
  of the report: gun 23631 saved 0/27, now 0/28; bracelet 60000 saved 2/1, now 1/5. Native bug: any item, any
  slot, with or without our features. The accessory_slot switch-by-uid caves (0.6.44/0.6.45/0.8.4) sit on the
  worn-row (con 1) and archive (con 9) paths and never see a backpack row.
- Fix (manifest 2.3.0, schema 3, memory only): hook 5 bytes at 0x08126556 (`mov eax,[esi+8] ; test eax,eax`, first
  read of each row of the equip loop) -> cave 0x08A16000 (107 bytes, rx, page reserved in the claims ledger). For a
  backpack row (con 0) the cave calls the native `CCharacter::FindEquipTrainItemLocation` @0x0840B500 with the row
  uid (character fields 0xD54/0xD58/0xD5C borrowed on the stack, restored); found in the backpack map -> the row's
  slot and page are rewritten before the native check, which then passes, and `SwitchItemLocation` equips from the
  real place (the native `UpdateFastDressFromInfo` of the equip refreshes the saved row and the database). Not found,
  or found worn: row untouched (native outcome). Worn rows (con 1) and archive rows (con 9) never reach the lookup.
- `deploy.py` 2.3.0: a patch that jumps into a manifest segment is memory only and is never written on disk (prod
  without launcher keeps the 3 byte patches; the sort fix needs the launcher).
- Tests: new `server/test_bagrow_emu.py <vanilla ZS>` (unicorn on the real ApplyFastDress bytes, the real
  FindEquipTrainItemLocation and _Rb_tree_increment, backpack and equipment maps built like the ZoneServer's): vanilla
  reproduces the report (S1 gun, S2 bracelet: 6480), with the manifest 10/10 (moved by the sort, another page, item
  gone, worn, con 1 and con 9 untouched, uid 0). `test_deploy.py` 25/25, `gen_mempatch.py --check`, mempatch_check
  0 error.
- Client: unchanged (GEAR_SWAP_VERSION not bumped here, the client code is being edited elsewhere).

checklist.item: Setup: Settings > Features, tick 'Gear Swap' and its option 'Presets 4-12'. Open the Gear Swap window and keep some spare gear in the bag.
Twelve presets: the Gear Swap window shows 12 tabs; put gear on pages 1, 4 and 12, Save Settings, relog -> each page keeps its gear.
Switch: from page 1, Switch to page 4, then to page 12 -> the gear of each page is equipped, the old gear goes back to the bag, no 'unable to equip here', no crash.
Treasure Archive: store an item of page 4 in your Treasure Archive, Switch to page 4 -> in one click it leaves the archive and is equipped; the chat says it was taken out and switched in.
HUD buttons: the small preset buttons of the HUD show presets 1 to 12; click the 7th -> preset 7 is equipped as with the Gear Swap window.
Two archive items: put 2 items of one preset in the Treasure Archive, Switch to it -> both come out and are equipped; the chat says 2 items were taken out.

Bag full: with too few free bag slots, Switch to a preset whose item is in the Treasure Archive -> nothing changes and the chat says how many free bag slots you need. Free some, click again -> it works.
Twelve presets: the Gear Swap window shows 12 tabs; put gear on pages 1, 4 and 12, Save Settings, relog -> each page keeps its gear.
Switch: from page 1, Switch to page 4, then to page 12 -> the gear of each page is equipped, the old gear goes back to the bag, no 'unable to equip here', no crash.
Full restart: close the game completely and start it again -> presets 1 to 12 still hold their gear.
Treasure Archive: store an item of page 4 in your Treasure Archive, Switch to page 4 -> in one click it leaves the archive and is equipped; the chat says it was taken out and switched in.

Bag full: with too few free bag slots, Switch to a preset whose item is in the Treasure Archive -> nothing changes and the chat says how many free bag slots you need. Free some, click again -> it works.
Sorted bag: save a preset, then sort your bag (or move its items to other bag slots) and Switch to it -> every item is equipped, no 'equipment does not exist' message.
HUD buttons: the small preset buttons of the HUD show presets 1 to 12; click the 7th -> preset 7 is equipped as with the Gear Swap window.
Two archive items: put 2 items of one preset in the Treasure Archive, Switch to it -> both come out and are equipped; the chat says 2 items were taken out.
Double click: double-click Switch on a preset with an item in the Treasure Archive -> the item is taken out only once.
Hotbar key: put a one-handed weapon on hotbar key 4. Both hands full, press 4 -> the main hand is replaced. Shift + 4 -> the off hand is replaced. Shift + a skill or potion key does nothing more.
Bind confirmation: Shift + right-click a one-handed weapon that asks before it binds to you. Confirm -> it goes to the off hand. Cancel -> nothing changes.

Quick 2nd right-click: tick 'Quick 2nd right-click: off hand'. Both hands full: right-click A, then B within 4 s -> A main hand, B off hand. Wait 5 s, right-click C -> main hand. Never replaces a shield.
Option off: untick 'Shift + right-click: other hand' under Gear Swap -> Shift + right-click acts like a plain right-click. Tick it again -> it works again at once, no restart.
Hand pick setup: Settings > Features, under Gear Swap tick 'Shift + right-click: other hand' and 'Hotbar off-hand slots' (both off by default). Use a dual-wield class with 3 or 4 one-handed weapons.
Plain right-click unchanged: one one-handed weapon worn, off hand empty, right-click a 2nd one -> it goes to the off hand. Right-click a 3rd -> it replaces the main hand, as before. No delay.
Shift + right-click, both hands full: hold Shift and right-click a one-handed weapon in the bag -> it replaces the OFF-hand weapon; the main hand does not move, the old weapon goes to the bag.

checklist.item: Both weapons switch: save two Gear Swap presets with different one-handed weapons in each hand, Switch between them -> both hands change every time.

Off-hand hotbar slot: with 'Hotbar off-hand slots' on, Ctrl + left-click a hotbar slot holding a one-handed weapon -> the slot is tinted; its key now puts the weapon in the off hand.

Channel change: switch to a preset, then change channel -> the gear stays as switched and every preset is still filled.
Other character: log in with another character -> it has its own 12 presets, never the gear of the first character.
Spam clicks: click Switch on two different presets very fast several times -> you end with one full preset on, nothing lost or duplicated, no crash.
Bracelet unchanged: with the Gear Swap options on, right-click a bracelet in the bag -> it is equipped in the bracelet slot, as before.
Pages unchanged: with the Gear Swap options on, click a costume page and a glyph page -> both switch as usual.
Bag tools unchanged: with the Gear Swap options on, select several bag items at once and use Bulk Use -> it works as before.
Auto sell unchanged: with the Gear Swap options on, sell to a shop with auto sell -> the same items are sold as before.
Gear Swap off: untick 'Gear Swap' in Settings > Features -> the Gear Swap window has only presets 1-3; tick it -> presets 4-12 come back with their gear.
Seen by others: player B stands next to A; A switches to another preset -> B sees A's new weapons and armor.
Dead: die and, still dead, click Switch on another preset -> no crash, nothing lost; after reviving, Switch works again.

checklist.item: Open: type /grimoire -> the Grimoire window opens in the middle of the screen, fully visible in 1280x720: 'Forms learned: n / 838 - k ready to wear', a bar, the category tree on the left and the form cards.
Close: Grimoire open -> Escape closes it without opening the game menu; the cross and the Close button close it too.
Shortcut icon: look under the minimap -> a purple book 'Grimoire' icon; hover: tooltip; click: the window opens and the icon stays pressed; click again: it closes. Works in Aven and in a dungeon.
Hotkey: Settings > Hotkeys, give a key to 'Grimoire window' -> pressing that key opens the Grimoire, pressing it again closes it.
Locked Open World form: category Open World, hover a locked card -> 'Unknown form (Lv N) - lives in <map>. Defeat it to learn its form.'
Form details: click a locked Open World card -> gold frame on the card; the right panel shows the silhouette, 'Level N', 'Found in <map>', 'Progress' and 'Chance 1 in 4, sure at 6'.
Pages and filter: click > and < -> the next 8 forms show, then the previous ones; the level filter list keeps only the forms of the chosen levels.
Sense a form: kill a low Open World form monster (Island Turtle in Graceland Marsh) -> 'Grimoire: you sensed a form you can learn (1/6)...'; its card shows '1 / 6' next to the padlock.
Learn by kills: keep killing that monster -> by the 6th kill at the latest: 'Grimoire: new form - <name> (Open World)! ...'; the card shows its portrait, its name and 'Learned'.
Unlock show: when a form unlocks (game sound on) -> the level-up fanfare plays and a short firework pops on your character.
Unlock with the window open: a form unlocks while the Grimoire is open -> its card gets selected and the bottom line says 'New form learned: <name>! Press Transform to try it.'
Pet kill: let your pet or your summon land the last hit on a form monster -> the kill counts for you ('n / 6' goes up).
Map change keeps progress: kill a form monster, take a portal, kill a form monster on the new map -> the progress keeps counting, no need to reopen the window.
Transform: pick a learned form, press 'Transform (60 s)' out of combat -> you look like that monster, the chat says 'you take the form of ... for 60 s', the top right reads 'Active: <form> 0:59'.
Others see it: a second player stands next to you when you transform -> he sees you as the monster, then sees your normal look come back at the end.
Transformation buff: at the start of a form -> the game's transformation effect plays and the buff bar shows a buff named 'Transformation'.
Hit while transformed: let a monster hit you once during a form -> the form stays until its 60 s are over.
End of form: wait 60 s -> 'your ... form fades', normal look back; the top right reads 'Next transformation in 2:00' and counts down to 'Ready to transform'.
Rest time: during the 3 minutes after a form starts -> the Transform button is grey and reads 'Ready in m:ss'; it cannot be pressed.
Revert: transform, then press Revert (or type /grimoire off) -> the form ends at once and the rest time keeps counting.
Not transformed: type /grimoire off while not transformed -> 'Grimoire: you are not transformed.'; type it twice fast -> only one line.
In a fight: hit a monster, then press Transform during the fight -> 'You cannot transform during a fight. Wait until the fight is over.' and nothing happens.
On a mount: press Transform while riding -> 'Get off your mount first.' and nothing happens.
In a dungeon: out of combat inside a dungeon or a trial, press Transform -> 'Transformations only work in the open world, not in dungeons, trials or PvP maps.'
Dead: press Transform while dead -> refused, you stay as you are.
During events: in Aven while a Prop Hunt or Infection game runs on your channel, or during a Battle Royale round -> Transform says 'Transformations are off during events here.'
Map change ends the form: transform, then take a portal, teleport or enter a dungeon -> 'Grimoire: your <name> form fades.' and you arrive with your normal look; the rest time keeps counting.
Relog: log out while transformed, log back in -> normal look. Change channel and open /grimoire -> all your forms are still there.
Option off: Settings > Features, untick 'Grimoire' with the window open -> it closes; /grimoire says 'Grimoire is turned off (Settings > Features).'; tick it -> /grimoire works without restart.
Look of the window: open /grimoire -> dark panels, every text white, gold or grey and readable, nothing cut; learned forms show the monster's portrait on the card and in the gold frame.
Favorites: select a learned form, press 'Add to favorites' -> its card says 'Favorite' and the tab 'Favorites (1)' lists it; 'Remove favorite' takes it out.
Favorites kept: add a favorite (a boss form like Kekabu too), close the game and start it again -> Favorites still lists them.
Learned tab: click 'Learned' -> only learned forms of the chosen category; in a category with none -> 'No form learned here yet...'.
Active card: transform from the window -> the selected card says 'Active 0:59' in green, the button reads 'Transformed 0:59' (grey), Revert is enabled; after the form, Revert is grey again.
/grimoire help: type it -> 'Grimoire: forms from your Monster Conquests achievements and from open-world kills. /grimoire opens it, /grimoire off takes back your own look.'
Muted game: Settings > Audio, mute the game, then unlock a form -> no fanfare, but the firework and the chat line still come; unmute -> the next unlock plays the fanfare.
Unlock while transformed: during a form kill unlearned form monsters until one unlocks -> fanfare and chat line at once, you stay in your form until 60 s, the firework pops after.
Escape order: open the Loot Tracker (Alt+L), then the Grimoire -> the first Escape closes the Grimoire, the second the Loot Tracker.
First login summary: first login since the boss forms came -> one chat line 'Grimoire: your Monster Conquests taught you N forms (M ready to wear). ...' with your own numbers.
No repeat: log out and back in with nothing new learned -> no summary line.
Category tree: /grimoire -> All, the Lv 01-30 to Lv 76-90 dungeon groups, Guild Bosses, Rare Monsters and Open World, each with learned / total; no Lv 91-100 group.
Tree note: look under the category tree -> 'Chests and a few other achievements give no form.'
Boss form: Guild Bosses, pick a boss whose achievement you have (e.g. Kekabu) -> the card reads 'Lv 80 - Arid Wilds' and the detail 'Looks like: Roonita'.
Wear a boss form: transform into a learned boss in the open world, outside Aven -> you get the boss's look at an ordinary monster size (about 3 m, not giant); it fades at 60 s.
Too big: Guild Bosses > Arachnolessia (if learned) -> card and button read 'Too big for now', the button is grey; the text ends 'This form is too big to wear for now.'
Locked boss: Lv 01-30 Dungeons > Mori Mori -> red '?' portrait, padlock, 'Lv 8 - Angor Quarry'; detail 'Locked. Earn the achievement "Pit Cleaner" (Achievements > Monster Conquests) ...'
Learn a boss form: in Angor Quarry kill Mori Mori -> 'Pit Cleaner' achievement popup, then within 6 s 'Grimoire: new form - Mori Mori (Lv 01-30 Dungeons)! ...'.
No firework inside: learn a form inside a dungeon -> no firework there; it pops once you are back outside.
Fight first: right after the Mori Mori kill press Transform -> 'You cannot transform during a fight. Wait until the fight is over.'
Party credit: in a party with a 2nd character, kill Herak -> both get 'Grimoire: new form - Herak ...' within a few seconds (at the latest when reopening the window, 2 minutes).
Open World form in Aven: an Open World form you learned (e.g. Elemental Mutant) -> Transform works, also in Aven.
Boss form in Aven: when 'Ready to transform', in Aven press Transform on a boss form -> 'Boss forms are not allowed in town yet.'
(GM) Grant: on a test character type /set_achievement 57501 1 0 -> within 2 minutes the chat says form Appacka is learned and the Grimoire lists it.
(GM) Batch: give 4 or more conquest achievements within 5 s with /set_achievement -> one single line 'Grimoire: 4 new forms learned. To see them, type /grimoire.'
Form and mount or duel: transformed (boss form), get on a mount, then start a duel -> refused or the form ends cleanly; no crash, no monster model left behind.
Big form: in a form of about 4 m, put the camera against a wall or a door, click an NPC and take a portal -> the camera stays usable, the NPC answers, the portal works.
Tooltip on screen: in 1280x720, Lv 76-90 Dungeons > Agazki, hover its card -> the 2-line tooltip is fully on screen.
Texts: Guild Bosses > Spicarium -> 'Achievement: Acupuncture session is over.' (one dot); Lv 01-30 Dungeons > Kedar -> ends '... Dee Dee!' (no extra dot).
Rest row: Lv 01-30 Dungeons > Ketak -> the third info row reads 'Rest' / '3 minutes'.
No fixed place: Guild Bosses, a boss that lives nowhere fixed -> 'Found in: No fixed place'.
No wearable form: a character whose learned forms are all too big or not wearable yet -> the header reads 'No form ready to wear yet'.
(GM) Boss looks check: on a GM test character wear every boss look one by one while a second player watches -> report any look that is invisible, broken, giant or crashes the game.
Party kill: in a party, let your partner land the last hit on an Open World form monster -> only he gets the progress; your 'n / 6' on that card does not move.
Daily limit: learn 20 Open World forms within 24 hours -> after that, kills of other form monsters no longer move their 'n / 6' until the next day.
Favorites on another character: add a favorite, then log in another character on the same PC -> the 'Favorites' tab lists the same forms.
Rest time after relog: transform, log out and back in at once, open /grimoire -> the Transform button still reads 'Ready in m:ss' and keeps counting down.
Two forms at once: two players next to each other transform at the same time -> each sees the other as his monster, and both normal looks come back after 60 s.
Guild window bar: the 3 icons next to Guild Benefits look like the Guild Call horn (gold and red). Click the chest: the bank opens and the Guild Benefits box never shows.
Click the blue crystal: a box asks to teleport to Aven (with the fee); OK teleports you, Cancel does nothing, and no Guild Benefits box appears.
Click the gavel: the auction house opens at once, no Guild Benefits box. The Guild Benefits button itself still opens the full box.
Speed: move the mouse onto the chest, then click -> the bank opens about as fast as your ping, never after a visible pause.
Talk to an NPC, close it, then click the chest or the gavel at once -> the right window opens (bank or auction), never an NPC shop.
Visual tab: open the guild window -> a 4th tab 'Visual' follows the 3 usual tabs, which still work -> it shows 'Current emblem' at 64 px and 32 px, the same emblem as above your head.
Import a GIF: Visual tab > Import image / GIF, pick an animated GIF -> both 'New emblem' previews play it (64 px and 32 px) and the info line shows the frame count and the speed.

Emblem tools: try Static frame < >, Speed - +, Zoom - +, the Position arrows, Center, Outline - + and a colour, Background colour, Transparent, Custom colour... -> each change updates the previews at once.

Apply an animated emblem: as leader of a guild of level 3+, Apply an animated GIF -> the status says it was sent; within a minute every player sees it above the leader's head, Eden players see it move.
Once per minute: Apply again within 60 s -> 'Please wait N s: the emblem can change once per minute.' and nothing is sent.
Apply refused: press Apply as a member who is not the leader, then as leader of a guild below level 3, then with no guild -> each time a clear message says why and the emblem does not change.
Animated icons option: Visual tab, untick 'Show animated guild icons above heads' -> animated emblems stop moving; tick it -> they move again; restart the game -> your choice is kept.
Back to a still emblem: 60 s after an animated one, Apply a plain PNG -> every player sees it and the animation stops; colours stay true (red stays red) and transparent parts stay transparent.
Big GIF: import a very large animated GIF (several MB) -> the game keeps running while it loads; change zone, go to character select and back -> the Visual tab and previews come back, no crash.
Any picture: guild Settings tab, the usual Test / Upload buttons -> the file window lists 'Images (png, jpg, gif, bmp, ico, tif, webp, dds)' and a picture of any size works.
Guild icons off: Settings > Features > Guild, untick 'Guild icons' and restart the game -> no Visual tab, the usual file window and only the usual emblems.

Warehouse size: tick 'Guild warehouse 100 slots' and restart the game, open the guild warehouse -> it is taller, each tab has 100 slots (10 x 10); Log, Close and the rank icons sit in one line under row 10.
Warehouse ready: open the guild warehouse with the 100-slot option on -> no error message, and depositing or taking items works as in the next rows.
Deposit to a high slot: drag a bag item onto an empty slot above 40 (e.g. tab 3 slot 60) -> it appears in that exact slot at once.
Tab full at 100: tab 1 holds 95 items, deposit 5 more -> the 100th works; the 101st is refused with 'Guild Warehouse is full'.
Drop on a full slot: drag a bag item onto a FULL warehouse slot -> it goes to the first free slot of the tab (above 40 when 1-40 are full).
Normal client safety: a player WITHOUT the 100-slot option (or on a normal client) opens tab 1 with slots 1-40 full -> dropping on a full slot or right-clicking a bag item deposits nothing, no error.
Withdraw from a high slot: right-click an item in a slot above 40 -> it goes to your bag and the slot empties.
Kept after relog: relog, then change character and back -> every item is still in the same slot, slots 41-100 included.
Other member sees it: a second guild member on another channel opens the warehouse -> he sees the deposits and withdrawals in slots above 40 (live, or after reopening).
Move: pick up a warehouse item with a left-click and drop it on an EMPTY warehouse slot (1 free bag slot needed) -> it moves there, passing through the bag briefly.
Swap: drop a warehouse item on an OCCUPIED warehouse slot (2 free bag slots needed) -> the two items swap in about 1 s; no 'move was interrupted' message, nothing left in the bag.
Moves in a row: do 3 moves or swaps, each right after the last one ends -> all complete; a drop or deposit during a move is refused with 'a move is in progress, try again in a moment.'
Move refused: try a move with a full bag -> the 'inventory full' message; with a guild rank that has no warehouse right -> the rights message; nothing moves.
No loss, no copy: after several moves and swaps -> the tab has the same item total and nothing is left or doubled in the bag; the warehouse Log shows each move as a withdraw + a deposit.
Stack move: move a stack (e.g. 999 potions) while the bag holds the same potion -> the whole stack moves and is not merged into the bag stack.
Interrupted move: start a move and at once close the window or walk away -> the item ends in the warehouse or in the bag, never lost ('move was interrupted' may show).
Warehouse stability: open a full tab, change zone and relog with the warehouse open -> no freeze, no crash.
Town test setup: a guild with a town and a GM who can see how many of its members are online -> note that number before each of the next 3 rows.
Town kept with 5 online: at least 5 members of the town's guild are ONLINE -> the town is not taken back (recycled) by the server.
Below 5 online: fewer than 5 members of the guild online -> the usual town rule applies again.
Creating a town: create a guild town -> it still needs the normal number of members.
Town List: tick 'Town merchant search' (Settings > Features > Guild), open the Town List at the town NPC -> it fills by itself, highest level first, the first town shown on the right, text readable.

Town search: in the Town List search box type part of a town name, then a leader's name, then 'gem' -> the list shrinks as you type, the counter shows e.g. '2 of 24 towns'; merchants keep the matches.
Town filters: pick a building (e.g. Farm), fill the town level boxes and pick an order (e.g. By name) -> all apply together; 'x' clears them; relog -> the building and order are still set.
Guild Benefits shortcuts: guild window, Info tab -> 3 icons right after 'Guild Benefits' (gold chest = Bank, blue crystal = Teleport, gavel and coin = Auction), sharp and not overlapping anything.
Bank and Auction shortcuts: click the Bank icon -> the bank opens as with 'Open Bank' on the Guild Benefits board; click the Auction icon -> the Auction House opens the same way.
Teleport shortcut: click the Teleport icon -> the same 'Teleport to Aven now?' box as on the board; No = nothing happens; Yes = you go to Aven, with the same fee as from the board.
Board already open: open the Guild Benefits board yourself, then click a shortcut icon -> the action runs at once.
Shortcuts off: Settings > Features > Guild, untick 'Guild Benefits shortcuts' with the guild window open -> the icons disappear at once; tick it again -> they come back.
No guild, no icons: on a character with no guild the shortcut icons never show; with a guild, change zone and go to character select and back -> they still work, no crash.

Call horn: as the guild leader open the guild window (Info tab) -> a horn icon sits at the right of the bottom bar, left of Leave / Disband, after the 3 shortcuts; hover -> 'Emergency call' ... 'Ready.'
No horn for members: as a member who is not the leader, or on a character with no guild -> the call horn is never shown.
Call sent: leader in Aven or an open map, 2 members with the Eden client far away on the same channel -> click the horn, Yes -> 'Emergency call sent to 2 guild members. Next call in 60 min.'
Join the call: a member gets 'Guild emergency call! <leader> calls the guild to <map>. Join now?' -> Join -> he lands next to the leader and reads 'You answered the emergency call: welcome to <map>.'
Call summary: one member joined, one declined -> the leader reads 'Emergency call over: 1 joined you (<name>), 1 declined, 0 did not answer.'
Call cooldown: right after 'Emergency call over: ...' click the horn again -> 'Emergency call is recharging: N min left.'; the horn is grey and its tooltip shows the time left.
Not from instances: leader in a dungeon, arena, battlefield or other instance clicks the horn -> refused: 'Emergency call works only in Aven and the open world ...'.
Dead leader: the leader is dead and clicks the horn -> the call is refused with a clear message and no cooldown starts.
Leader moved away: the leader enters a dungeon after calling -> a member who presses Join reads 'Your guild leader is no longer in a place you can join.' and stays where he is.
Nobody to call: no member can be asked -> 'Emergency call: nobody to call right now (...). No cooldown used.' and the leader can call again at once.
Call off: Settings > Features > Guild, untick 'Guild emergency call' with the guild window open -> the horn disappears at once and any open call box closes; tick it again -> it comes back.
Sakura Island: the leader on Sakura Island (Battle Royale island) clicks the horn -> refused with 'Emergency call works only in Aven and the open world ...'; a member there is counted busy.
Box after another box: while the call box is open the member gets another confirmation (e.g. a card duel invite) -> after answering it, the call box comes back if the 60 s are not over.
Zone change during the box: the member changes zone while the call box is open -> the box closes, the leader's summary counts him as declined; after loading, a new call reaches him.
Small and big screens: as the leader, guild window open at 1280x720 and at 2560x1440 -> the horn never covers the 3 shortcuts nor Leave / Disband (it gets smaller or hides).
Horn look: guild window Info tab as the leader -> the call button is a golden war horn with a red guild banner; lighter on hover, pushed in when clicked, grey during the cooldown.
After a mini-game: 2 members play a Werewolf or Infection game in Aven to the end, then walk away from the leader -> the leader calls -> 'Emergency call sent to 2 guild members. Next call in 60 min.'
Join after a mini-game: right after such a game -> each member gets the call box; Join brings him next to the leader with 'You answered the emergency call: welcome to <map>.'
Already next to you: all members stand right next to the leader -> the call says 'Emergency call: nobody to call right now (2 already next to you). No cooldown used.'
Long stay: members stay 10 minutes in Aven without changing map -> the leader calls -> they still get the call box.
After a relog: a member goes to character select and back -> the leader calls -> the member gets the call box again.

Guild Call on the shortcut bar: as the leader, the bar under the minimap has a 'Guild Call' icon (gold horn) -> click it with the guild window closed -> the game's confirmation asks; Yes -> members get the box.
War horn sound: the leader calls a member far away -> the leader hears the war horn (about 2 s); the member hears the same horn once when the Join / Decline box opens.
Bar case pressed: while the call runs, the Guild Call case of the shortcut bar looks pressed (lit); it goes back to normal when the leader reads 'Emergency call over: ...'.
Fireworks: a member clicks Join -> fireworks show above the leader's head for about 4 s, and the summary names who came, e.g. 'Emergency call over: 1 joined you (Ken), 0 declined, 0 did not answer.'

(GM) Server not answering: staff stops the guild call service on DEV; the leader calls -> about 15 s later 'Guild emergency call: no answer from the server.'; the horn is grey, tooltip 'Guild service not answering.'
Teleport refused: a member in a team of more than 10 (or on a battlefield) presses Join -> he reads 'The teleport to your guild leader failed.' instead of 'welcome to ...' and stays.
Esc with Loot Tracker: the member has the Loot Tracker open (Alt+L) when the call arrives -> he presses Esc -> the call box answers Decline first; the Loot Tracker stays until the next Esc.
Emblem Reset: change several settings in the Visual tab, then click Reset -> every setting goes back to default and the imported picture is kept.
Graphics change: with the Visual tab open, change the graphics settings and Apply -> the tab and its previews come back, no crash.
Deposit pace: deposit items very fast (less than 0.5 s apart) -> the too-fast deposit is ignored and that item stays in your bag.
Right-click deposit: warehouse open, tab 1 slots 1-40 full -> right-click a bag item -> it goes to the first free slot above 40.
Warehouse option off: untick 'Guild warehouse 100 slots', restart the game and open the warehouse -> the normal 40-slot window; tick it and restart again -> the items above 40 are still there.
Town goods: in the Town List pick a goods type (e.g. potions) -> only towns with a merchant selling it stay, and the merchant table says e.g. '3 of 9 merchants match'.
Town Refresh: press Refresh in the Town List -> the list reloads with the current towns and keeps your search and filters.
Town search off: untick 'Town merchant search' and reopen the Town List -> the game's normal Town List is back.
Case and accents: type a town or merchant word in upper case or without its accents -> the same towns are found.
Shortcut tooltips: hover each of the 3 Guild Benefits icons -> the tooltip names its action (bank, teleport to Aven, auction house).
Decline the call: the member presses Decline (or the X, or Esc) -> the box closes at once and the leader's summary counts him as declined.
No answer: the member does not answer -> the box closes by itself after 60 s (its gold bar runs out) and the leader's summary counts him in 'did not answer'.
Still waiting: the leader clicks the horn again while his call waits for answers -> 'Your emergency call is still waiting for answers.'
Busy members: a member in a dungeon or an event (Prop Hunt, Battle Royale, Alpaca Race) -> the leader calls -> that member is not asked and the 'sent' line counts him as busy.
Leader in an event: the leader is registered in Prop Hunt or Battle Royale and clicks the horn -> the call is refused with a matching message.
Dead member: a member dies before answering, then presses Join -> 'You cannot join your guild leader while dead.'
Other channel: a member is online on another channel -> the leader calls -> that member is never asked.
Normal client member: a member on the normal game client, same channel -> the leader calls -> he is not asked and the line counts him as without the Eden patch.
Alone on the channel: no other guild member online on the channel -> the leader calls -> 'Emergency call: no other guild member to call on this channel right now. No cooldown used.'
Bar for members: as a simple member -> no Guild Call icon on the shortcut bar (greyed in its list with 'Only for a guild leader.').
Horn muted: game volume 0 or sound muted in Settings > Audio -> the leader calls -> no horn sound for him; a muted member hears nothing either.
(GM) Server back: staff starts the guild call service again -> the leader clicks the horn once -> within 2 s it is back to 'Ready.' and the next click opens the confirmation.
(GM) No call loop: while the guild call service is stopped, click the horn or the bar case -> 'Guild emergency call is not available right now: the guild service does not answer.', no repeating line.
Cooldown after relog: during the 60 min cooldown the leader relogs -> the horn is still grey and shows the time left.
Call window stability: with the guild window open, change zone, go to character select and back, then Game Reset (Alt+Enter) -> the horn still works, no crash.
Guild icons back on: tick 'Guild icons' again (Settings > Features > Guild) -> the Visual tab and the animated emblems come back.
Warehouse option label: Settings > Features > Guild -> 'Guild warehouse 100 slots' shows '(needs a restart)' after its name; the other guild options work at once.
Late arrival sees the emblem: the leader applied an animated emblem; B quillash in later on the same channel and walks next to him -> B sees the new emblem above the leader's head.
Emblem kept after relog: the leader applied a new emblem, everybody relogs -> the new emblem is still above the members' heads, not the old one.
Emblem on another channel: a member was on another channel when the leader applied it -> he changes to the leader's channel and walks next to him -> he sees the new emblem.
Shortcut teleport without gold: with less gold than the fee, click the Teleport icon and Yes -> the same refusal as from the Guild Benefits board, you stay where you are.
Shortcuts kept after relog: untick 'Guild Benefits shortcuts', relog -> the icons stay hidden; tick it -> they come back.
Call option kept after relog: untick 'Guild emergency call', relog -> the horn and the Guild Call icon stay hidden; tick it -> they come back.
Party member called: a member in the leader's party, far away on the same channel -> the leader calls -> the member gets the call box like the others.
Two members in the warehouse: A and B open the same tab -> A deposits in slot 50 -> B sees it in slot 50 after reopening; B takes it -> A sees slot 50 empty after reopening.
Setup: have a healer with some healing gear and a second player you can inspect.
Magic block: open Character Info -> the block is named 'Magical Attributes' and reads M-ATK, Cast SPD, G-Healing, M-CRIT Rate, M-CRIT DMG.
Defensive block: open Character Info -> the block reads DEF, P-Healing, EVA, Parry, Block, all in English.
Real numbers: on a character with healing gear, Character Info shows real numbers for G-Healing and P-Healing, not 0 and not empty.
Line tooltips: hover the G-Healing and P-Healing lines in Character Info -> each shows a tooltip explaining it.
Gear change: equip or remove a piece of healing gear -> both numbers update.
Level and class: gain a level or switch class -> G-Healing and P-Healing are recalculated and still make sense.
Temporary heal buff: use a temporary heal buff or a heal enchant -> the game goes on normally; the two healing rows do not have to change.
Other players: inspect another player -> his sheet shows the two healing lines with his own numbers, not yours and not zero.
Kept after relog: relog, then change channel -> the healing numbers come back the same, never back to 0.
Monsters: target a monster and look at its stats -> no healing line appears, and targeting never freezes the game.
Other stats: every other stat in Character Info (P-ATK, HP, MP, resistances...) shows its usual value and nothing moved by one line.
Heal spam: in a party, spam heals for a while, change zone and relog -> the game never freezes.
After channel change: change channel, then open Character Info -> both healing rows are filled, their tooltips show, and they still follow gear changes.
Inspect after map change: change map, then inspect two different players -> each time the healing rows show that player's own numbers, never an empty line.
Points and percent: open Character Info -> each healing row shows points then a percent (like '1200 +58.4%'). Equip a WIS item -> both percents rise; remove it -> they come back exactly.
Percent bonus: equip a 'G-Healing +X%' bonus -> only the G-Healing percent rises, by exactly X. Same with a P-Healing % bonus -> only P-Healing moves.
Value tooltips: hover the G-Healing value -> your numbers and a 'Heal cast' HP range; P-Healing shows a 'Self-heal' range. Both change with WIS gear.
WIS buff: take a WIS buff -> both healing percents go up, and come back down when the buff ends.
Real heals: heal yourself a few times with and without WIS gear -> the healed amounts rise and fall together with the percents in Character Info.
Fast gear changes: Character Info open, equip and remove several items quickly -> the sheet ends on the right values, no line stuck or at 0, no freeze.
Green crit off: Settings > Features, under Heal Stats untick 'Green critical heal numbers' -> critical heals show as normal heal numbers.
Green crit on: tick 'Green critical heal numbers' again -> a critical heal shows a big green number again.
Feature off: untick Heal Stats in Settings > Features -> both healing rows in Character Info show '-'. Tick it again -> the numbers come back.
Off kept after relog: untick Heal Stats in Settings > Features -> relog -> both healing rows in Character Info still show '-'.
Party healer: in a party, inspect a healer who wears healing gear -> his G-Healing and P-Healing rows show his own numbers.

Certificate swap, same board twice: note both healing rows with Tuner II in a slot, swap it for Devoted Belief II, then put Tuner II back -> the rows show exactly the first numbers again (the 0.25.0 server part sends the sheet after the swap and after its set bonuses).

Order does not matter: from the Tuner II board, go through Pop Star II and back to Tuner II, then through Devoted Belief II and back -> both returns to Tuner II show the same G-Healing / P-Healing numbers.
Probe in the log: after a swap, %LOCALAPPDATA%\EdenReforgedData\quillash\eden_hook.log has '[heal_probe] Character Info: ...' lines; the last line of the swap is the number on screen.
(GM) Setup: a GM account on DEV, Reforged Studio connected to DEV, and a character that wears a weapon. Stay logged in during all these tests: nobody should ever be disconnected.

(GM) In Reforged Studio change the damage type of your worn weapon (for example Piercing to Slashing) and save: 'Applied live', no 'restart required' banner. Your next hits on a resistant monster change.
(GM) After that change, change channel and hit the same kind of monster: the new damage type applies on every channel, without relog or re-equip.
(GM) Set a weapon's damage type to 12 (outside 0-9) and save: refused with a banner, nothing changes in game. Put a valid value back before any server restart.
(GM) Change the damage type of an armour and save: the tool says 'restart required' (weapons only); in game nothing changes before a restart.
(GM) Type /show_monster 63280 and note its HP. In Reforged Studio change its HP and save: 'Applied live'. Type /show_monster 63280 again: the new HP, no server restart.
(GM) After that HP change, kill one of those monsters and wait for its respawn: the new one has the new HP. One that was already there before the change keeps its old HP.
(GM) Back to normal: in Reforged Studio put the original values back and save -> the monster and the weapon behave exactly as before.
(GM) Loot: in Reforged Studio give a monster standing near you an easy to spot item at 100 % in its loot and save. Kill that same monster: the item drops. Put the loot back.
(GM) Spell: change a visible value (cost, cooldown or range) of a spell you know and save. Cast it again without relog: the new value applies.
(GM) Monster behaviour: change the aggro range of a monster standing near you and save: that same monster changes its behaviour at once, no respawn needed.
(GM) Open your stats window and note P-ATK. Raise your worn weapon's attack by 2000 in Reforged Studio and save: within a few seconds P-ATK changes, without unequipping or relog.
(GM) After that, relog, then change channel: P-ATK is still the new value. Put the old attack back and save: P-ATK goes back, again without relog.
(GM) Keep a 2nd, already repaired copy of that weapon in your bag, change its attack, then equip it: new P-ATK at once and its durability 'x / y' does not change.
(GM) After an attack change, the weapon tooltip still shows the old value until the next client update, while the stats window already uses the new one. This is expected.
(GM) Change the attack of an evolving item and save: the tool says 'restart required' and the item does not change before a server restart.
(GM) Raise the required level of a weapon your character can wear above your level and save: 'restart required'. It still equips before a restart and is refused after. Put it back.
(GM) Sell price: change the sell price of a weapon and save: an NPC buys it at the new price at once. For a potion the old price stays until a server restart.
(GM) Change a quest and save: the tool always says 'restart required' (quests are never applied live).
(GM) After saving a change, type /reload_grow_table in the chat: the change applies on all 4 channels and nobody is disconnected. If the chat refuses the command, note its message.
(GM) Summon a pet or a combat totem and let it act; while it is active, change a monster in Reforged Studio and save: you stay connected and the pet or totem keeps casting.
(GM) Fight a boss that casts spells; during the fight, change a monster in Reforged Studio and save: the boss keeps casting its spells, not only basic attacks.
(GM) Other players: during all these changes, a 2nd player who stays logged in on another channel -> is never disconnected and keeps playing normally.
(GM) After a server restart: save a change that was applied live, then ask staff to restart the server -> after the restart the new value is still there.
Normal player refused: on a non-GM account type /reload_grow_table in the chat -> nothing is reloaded and you stay connected.
(GM) Party: while you are in a party, change your worn weapon's attack and save -> your party members are not disconnected and see your hits as usual.

prod.tests_status: protection anti-crash ou feature testee par les SA : toujours validee

checklist.item: Buy an Instant Rush Ticket in the Item Mall (points tab), walk into a 0/10 dungeon entrance (e.g. Southern Old Mine): the entrance window shows an 'Instant Rush' box between Confirm and Cancel, unticked.

Tick Instant Rush, pick the dungeon, press Confirm: you do not enter; one ticket leaves the bag, the x/10 of that dungeon goes up by 1, the chat says 'Instant Rush: <dungeon> cleared - +N EXP, n items ... sent to your mailbox.' and the mails arrive.
Box unticked + Confirm: normal entry into the dungeon, no ticket taken.
Without a ticket the box is grey with the tooltip 'You have no Instant Rush Ticket (Item Mall).'; at 10/10 the native window refuses as usual and no ticket is taken.
A dungeon outside the list (Dream of Destruction): tick Instant Rush then Confirm -> 'Instant Rush is not available for this dungeon.' and nothing is taken.
Rush a dungeon whose bosses have a Breaking Point bar: over a few rushes the mails also hold items of the 'BP System Drops' list of those bosses (native rates).
Relog after a rush: the x/10 counter of the dungeon still shows the extra entry.

Capacity gate (server manifest 1.3.0 + DLL inventory 1.10.0). Client WITHOUT the DLL (or extend_bag_slot off) on [GM]perrinumber (bags in bank cells 5-10): open the bank - no 'Runtime Error!', only the 4 usual bag slots and their pages; relog the same character WITH the DLL: the extra bag slot and every bag/item of cells 5-10 are still there (nothing lost). With the DLL on a normal character: bag slot 6 (Premium VIP) works as before.

Open the guild window, then open the bank at the NPC: the bank is in front of the guild window, and Escape closes it (with the other open windows). Move items in and out of the bank, close it, move items again: it never pops up by itself.
Open the bag and the bank: right size and column count.
Backpack Manager: change the column count, it applies.
Teleport and relog: sizes are kept, no crash.
Sort, split and right-click use still work.
Relog and teleport: bags and items are still there.
Fill most of your bag and relog: you log in normally.
F9 opens Bulk Use. Right-click a bag item: it goes in the slot. Esc closes it without opening the menu.
Use all on a stack: the whole stack is used at once, one message.
Box or unidentified weapon: pick a target, Until target: it stops when you get it.
Fortified weapon + reset scrolls: pick a stage and an ability, Until target: it stops on it, other stages unchanged.
Several stacks of the same item: Use all goes through all of them without re-placing.
Teleport or relog during a run: it stops, no crash, nothing lost or duplicated.
Open Bulk Use (F9), click 'Delete items...': the panel opens next to the bag.
Click or drag over items to mark them (red frame); drag again to unmark.
Quest items cannot be marked; 100 items max.
Delete: the confirm window lists the items and warns about rare or item mall items.
Destroy: exactly the marked items vanish, nothing else.
Relog or teleport with items marked: no crash, nothing stays drawn on screen.
At a shop, the items ticked in Sell options are sold and the gold arrives.

Auto sell 2.7.4: at a shop press Sell all (or Select... then Sell): every line of the review list starts with the item's own 32x32 icon (the same picture as in the bag and its tooltip), the name and price follow it, nothing is cut (a long line wraps on two lines), the mouse wheel and the scrollbar scroll the list with the icons following their lines. Same in Multi delete's confirmation (F11).
Nothing else is sold (check your gear and potions).
Change the Sell options boxes, relog: they are kept, no crash.
Selling an item by hand still works.
Open Settings > Hotkeys: 'Bulk Use window' shows F9 and 'Multi delete: mark items' shows F11.

In Settings > Hotkeys, Ctrl+B is refused for 'Bulk Use window' (game hotkey). Set it to Ctrl+H and Confirm: Ctrl+H opens and closes Bulk Use, F9 no longer does, and the minimap button tooltip says 'Bulk Use (Ctrl+H)' without relogging.
In Settings > Hotkeys, set 'Auto sell: mark items' to F11: the line says 'taken from Multi delete: mark items' and Multi delete becomes None.
After giving F11 to 'Auto sell: mark items' and pressing Confirm: in the bag, F11 starts the selling selection (not the delete one), and the Backpack Manager 'Selection key' row shows F11.
In Settings > Hotkeys, press Default then Confirm: 'Multi delete: mark items' is F11 again and 'Auto sell: mark items' has no key.
If you had already picked a selection key for selling in the Backpack Manager, after the update it is still the same key and Settings > Hotkeys shows it for 'Auto sell: mark items'.

In Settings > Features, tick 'Premium VIP bag slot' and restart the game. Open the bag, then the bank: a 6th bag slot sits next to the 5 usual ones, same size, covering nothing. Change the column count in the Backpack Manager: still true.
With Premium VIP: put a bag in slot 6 of the bag and a bank bag in slot 6 of the bank. Each grows by one page. Put items in it, relog and teleport: everything is still there.

Without Premium VIP: slot 6 shows a padlock and 'VIP required', and you cannot drop a bag or an item there. With your bag full, looting, buying, mail and trade say the bag is full and nothing is lost.
Click the sort button in the bag, then in the bank at the banker: the items are sorted, or the chat says why not (one sort every 3 minutes). Slot 6 never covers the sort button.
Fill the bag with many small stacks of the same items and click the sort button (with and without NeoInventoryBank): the game does not freeze while the stacks merge. If it lags, say for how long.

Only if you use the NeoInventoryBank mod, with Premium VIP: open the bag and the bank, at the first size and again at 20 columns. Slot 6 is right after bag 5, at the right end of the bag row; bags 1-5 and the sort button sit one place further left; nothing is covered. Drag an item onto each bag and click the sort button: both still work.
In Settings > Features, untick 'Premium VIP bag slot' with the bag and bank open: they close; reopen them: 5 bag slots, no crash. Then open the bank, hover slot 6 and quit the game: no crash report.
A character that had bags in the old extra bag slots (before the single VIP slot): the items inside still show and can be dragged out, nothing new can go there, and nothing is lost after relog.

Open Sell options (or Delete items) next to the bag, then open the Quest window or click the Character Info window over it: the native window comes in front. Click the Sell options panel: it comes back in front. Same with the Bank Slot Rental window.
Open the bank from the guild window (Open Bank) and with a portable bank: it shows in front, Escape closes it, walking away closes it; open it again right after: it shows again.

checklist.item: Setup: open the Item Support window -> put potions, candies and a cosmetic buff item in row 1 (top) and row 2 (bottom) -> both rows show the items with their counts.

Bag sorting, window open: Item Support window open, items in row 2 -> for 2 minutes drag items between bag cells, split and merge stacks, press the bag's sort button often -> no crash, row 2 keeps its items.
Empty row 2: empty every row 2 slot (or use a character that never used row 2) -> move items and sort the bag many times -> no crash.
Zone, channel and relog: items in row 2 -> change zone and channel a few times, go to character select and back -> no crash, row 2 shows the same items with the right counts.
Live counts: items in row 2 -> use, buy, move or sort those items -> row 2 icons and counts update at once and an empty stack turns grey, without reopening the window.
Row 2 Burn safety: cheap potion A in row 2, row 2 Burn ticked -> move A so that another usable item B sits in A's old bag cell, then sort, split and merge A -> only A is ever used, never B.
Row 1 Burn safety: row 1 Burn ticked with cheap items -> move and sort the bag -> only the item type set in row 1 is ever used.
Drag and drop: drag an item from the bag to row 2, from row 2 to another row 2 slot, and from row 2 to row 1 and back -> each move works, and items swap when the target slot is taken.
Cooldown: use a potion or candy from row 2 -> its cooldown sweep is smooth and the same as for that item in row 1.
Row settings kept: change the row 1 Burn box and the row 2 Enable and Burn boxes, press Settings -> relog -> each box keeps its state and still changes what gets used.
Buff auto-use: put a buff item in row 2 -> it is used when the buff is missing -> it is not used again while the buff is still on.
Tooltip after sort: sort the bag, then hover a row 2 item -> its own tooltip shows, never the one of the item now in its old bag cell.
Recovery while casting: HP potion in the Recovery section at 90%, row 1 Burn ticked, press Settings -> drop below 90% HP while casting skills one after another -> the HP potion is still drunk.
Grey after a change: tick row 2 Burn, or untick row 2 Enable, then sort the bag -> row 2 icons stay normal at once and do not stay grey until the next zone change.
Burn runs out: row 2 Burn ticked, a cheap potion in row 2 -> let it run out -> the slot turns grey and no other item is used. Buy that potion again -> Burn uses it again.
Row 1 item refused: drag an item that is already in row 1 onto a row 2 slot -> it is refused and row 1 does not change.
No double in row 2: put an item that is already in row 2 into another row 2 slot -> it leaves its old slot and shows only once.
Right-click remove: right-click an item in row 2 -> it is removed from the slot and the item is still in your bag.
Row 2 Enable: untick row 2 Enable -> row 2 items are no longer used. Tick it again -> they are used again.
No waste after channel change: a row 2 buff item with its buff still on -> change channel, then sort the bag -> it is not used again and its count does not drop.
Drag start: pick a row 2 item up with the mouse and drop it on another slot, on the bag, then outside the window -> no crash each time.
Row 1 Burn speed: empty row 2, cheap potions in row 1 with the Check box on, row 1 Burn ticked, press Settings -> the row 1 potions are used fast, about 3 per second.
Mount slots refused: drag a row 2 item onto a mount slot, then a mount onto a row 2 slot -> both are refused with the game's message and nothing moves.
Revive slot swap: swap a row 2 item with the item in a revive slot -> the swap works and both slots show the right item.
Fortify not broken: auto-use on, open the Fortify window and fortify an item several times -> the bar always finishes and nothing from row 1 or row 2 is used while it runs.
Arcane Box not broken: auto-use on, open several Arcane Boxes in a row -> the bar always finishes and nothing from row 1 or row 2 is used while it runs.
Star Stone used once: put a Star Stone in row 1 or row 2 while its buff is missing -> it is used once -> it is not used again every few seconds.
Colour after relog: potions in row 1, row 2 and the Recovery section -> go to the character list and back in a few times -> a second after entering, the slots show in colour, not grey.
Luna Rock and Star Stone swap: both buffs on, swap both slots to another stat pair, OK, wait 1 min, right-click off the old Luna and Star buffs -> both new stones are used within about 20 s.
Star Stone waits its turn: Star buff on, put a different Star Stone in row 1 -> nothing is used while the old buff is on -> remove the old Star buff -> the new stone is used within a few seconds.
No stone loop: put two Star Stones of different stats in row 1 (they replace each other) -> after 3 uses they stop for 2 minutes, stones are not used forever.
Bag sorting, window closed: Item Support window closed, items in row 2 -> move, split, merge and sort the bag for 2 minutes -> no crash, row 2 still has its items when you open it.
OK retries at once: a Star Stone in row 1 waiting because an old Star buff was on -> remove that buff, open Item Support and press OK -> the stone is tried again at once.
Feature off: Settings > Features, untick Item Support -> open the Item Support window -> row 2 and its Enable and Burn boxes are gone, row 1 works like the normal game.
Feature back on: after turning Item Support off, tick it again (no restart) -> row 2 and its boxes come back with the same items and settings.
Death: items in row 1 and row 2, auto-use on -> die, then revive -> no item is lost while dead and auto-use works again right after the revive.
Full bag: fill every bag cell, items in row 2 -> sort and move a few items -> no crash and the row 2 counts stay right.
Two characters: put different items in row 2 on character A and on character B -> play A, then B, then A again -> each character shows its own row 2.
Stack refilled: let a row 2 item run out (slot grey) -> buy or pick up the same item -> the slot turns colour again and auto-use starts again.
Off kept after relog: untick Item Support in Settings > Features -> relog -> it is still unticked and the Item Support window still has no row 2.
Real use: a potion in row 2 is drunk by auto-use -> the bag count of that potion drops by exactly one and your HP or MP really goes up.
Count after relog: let row 2 use a few potions -> relog -> the bag count of that potion is the same as row 2 showed before the relog.
Sold at a merchant: open a merchant and sell the whole stack of an item that sits in row 2 -> it is sold, its row 2 slot turns grey, no crash.
